sa: अत्र वृत्तेन वृत्रोऽपि शक्रशत्रुत्यमीयिवान्। अत्र सर्वासवः प्राप्ताः पुनर्गच्छन्ति पञ्चधा॥
en: Here by his habits of life did Vritra (the Asura) incur the hostility of Shankra and here do the lives of all being come and again dissolve into their five elephants.

sa: श्रुतास्ते शङ्खशब्दाश्च भेरीशब्दाश्च पुष्कलाः। कुञ्चराणां च नदतां व्यूढानीकेषु तिष्ठताम्॥
en: You have heard enough of the sound of my conch shells as well as that of trumpets and the roar of many elephants in the midst of soldiers arranged for battle.

sa: अत्र लोकत्रयस्यास्य पितृपक्षः प्रतिष्ठितः। अत्रोष्मपाणां देवानां निवासः श्रूयते द्विज॥
en: In this direction do the Pitris of the three worlds live and it is said, O twice born one, that this is the residence of those gods that subsist on smoke.

sa: अणोरणीयान् सुमनाः सर्वभूतेषु जाग्रति। पितरं सर्वभूतेषु पुष्करे निहितं विदुः॥
en: The supreme soul is subtler than the subtle, of noble mind and is present in all creatures. He is known as the universal father, dwelling in the heart of every creature,

sa: दशग्रीवश्च दैत्यानां देवानां च बलोत्कटः। आक्रम्य रत्नान्यहरत् कामरूपी विहङ्गमः॥
en: The terribly powerful, ten-headed (Ravana) assuming form at will and capable of going through the sky, attacked the gods and demons and took away by force from them their valuable property.

sa: मन्त्रस्य नियमं कुर्यास्त्वमत्र मधुसूदन। एतदत्र हितं मन्ये सर्वं यादवनन्दन॥
en: But you should not give out this conversation between ourselves, 0 slayer of Madhu, for I think that this alone leads to good in this instance, O delighted of all Yadavas.

sa: बहूनीह सहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। नागानामेकवंशानां यथाश्रेष्ठं तु मे शृणु॥
en: There are many thousands and millions and hundreds of millions of unaccountable Nagas, listen to me as I say the few names of the foremost among them of a single race.

sa: गुरुभारसहो दिव्यः शात्रवाणां भयंकरः। कस्यायं सायको दीर्घः शिलीपृष्ठः शिलीमुखः॥
en: Whose is this celestial long sword, capable of having heavy weight, irresistible, dreadful to the enemies, having the mark of a bee on it and with the head of a bee?

sa: विद्यावृद्धा वयोवृद्धाः क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभ। वृथा मृत्युं न कुर्वीरंस्त्वत्कृते मधुसूदन॥
en: Do not let those best of the Kshatriyas, who are old in learning and old in age meet with an useless death on account of your doings, O slayer of Madhu.

sa: दुपदस्य सुता ह्येषा वेदिमध्यात् समुत्थिता। अयोनिजा महाभागा स्नुषा पाण्डोर्महात्मनः॥
en: This lady is the daughter of Drupada and has sprung from the sacrificial altar. She is not begotten of flesh; she is the mighty and illustrious daughter-in-law of the high-souled Pandu.

sa: ब्राह्मणान् प्रथमं द्वेष्टि गुरूंश्च मधुसूदन। भृत्यान् भक्तिमतश्चापि तत् पराभवलक्षणम्॥
en: First he treats the Brahmanas with contempt and his elders, O slayer of Madhu, and then his servants who are attached to him and these are the signs if a defeat.

sa: नित्येव कृष्णश्च ततः कृतार्थः। एवंरूपे वासुदेवेऽप्रमेये महाबले गुणसम्पत् सदैव॥
en: Nor shall arms stick on your body. Krishna, too, at this considered himself gratificd. Such are ever the virtues of the son of Vasudeva of immeasurable fame and the great strength.

sa: प्रमदाः कामयानेषु यजमानेषु याजकाः। राजा विवदमानेषु नित्यं मूर्खेषु पण्डिताः॥
en: Immunity from malady, unindebtedness, the reverse of exile, coming in contact with good men, confidence in one's own livelihood and life without fear-these six, constitute the happiness of men, O king.

sa: पातु त्वां वरुणो राजा सलिले सलिलेश्वरः। अन्तरिक्षेऽन्तरिक्षस्थः पवनः सर्वगस्तथा॥
en: On the waters may king Varuna, the lord of waters, protect you. And similarly may Pavana (the wind-god) who ranges in the sky and wanders everywhere protect you in the sky.

sa: आज्ञापयध्वनिमिष्टानि प्रीयामो दर्शनेन वः। प्राप्य सर्वानभिप्रायांस्ततो व्रजत मा चिरम्॥
en: I am pleased to see you all. Command me what I can do for you. Having received all that you desire to have, go back to the place whence you came."

sa: इत्युक्तः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा दुःखितो भृशमातुरः। तेभ्यो न्यवेदयं तत्र प्रतिज्ञां पितृगौरवात्॥
en: Being thus spoken to an having joined my hands and being very much stuck with sorrow I represented to them the vow I was observing for the respect of my father.

sa: अनुवय॑ति तं चापि धृतराष्ट्रः सुतप्रियः। भीष्मद्रोणौ च कार्पण्यान्माद् राधेयसौबलौ॥
en: And Dhritarashtra, fond of his son, will follow him. So will Bhima and Drona out of a false regard for the kingdom and the two sons of Subala out of folly.

sa: पृथिव्यां चतुरन्तायां यदुरेवाभवद् बली। वशे कृत्वा स नृपतीन् न्यवसन्नागसाह्वये॥
en: In the four quarters of the globe, Yadu was the strongest man and having brought all the rulers of men under subjection he lived in the city called after the elephant.

sa: स श्रुत्वा माधवं यान्त सदश्वैरनिलोपमैः। बलेन नातिमहता द्वारकामभ्ययात् पुरीम्॥
en: Having heard that Madhava was on his way he set out for the city of Dwraka, with a retinue not large and good horses which could be compared to the wind.

sa: तौ निहत्य पृथग् धुर्यावुभौ तौ पार्ष्णसारथी। विरथं मत्स्यराजानं जीवग्राहमगृह्णताम्॥
en: Having slain severally his two horses, his charioteer as also the soldiers who protected him in the rear they took the king of Matsya captive, even alive, deprivation of his car.

sa: धर्मोऽहमिति भद्रं ते जिज्ञासुस्त्वामिहागतः। आनृशंस्येन तुष्टोऽस्मि वरं दास्यामि तेऽनघ॥
en: I am Dharma, May you be in bliss. I came here to test you and have been pleased with your spirit of mercy. O sinless one, I will give you boons.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे धर्मो भगवाँल्लोकभावनः। समेताः पाण्डवाश्चैव सुखसुप्ता मनस्विनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Saying this, the adorable Dharma, whom all the worlds pay homage to, disappeared. And the magnanimous sons of Pandu were joined together after they had enjoyed and agreeable sleep.

sa: अरोगान् सर्वसिद्धार्थान् क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि पाण्डवान्। ईश्वरान् सर्वलोकस्य हतामित्राश्रिया वृतान्॥
en: You will soon see the sons of Pandu without any illness and all their objects gained, the lords of all the world, with their enemies killed and themselves surrounded by prosperity.

sa: आहारप्रभवाः प्राणा मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम्। मनसश्चेन्द्रियाणां चाप्यैकाग्यं निश्चितं तपः॥
en: Life is sustained by food. The mind is however fickle and it is hard to keep it in subjection. The concentration of mind and the control of the constitute (true) asceticism.

sa: नैष्कर्म्यं वा समास्थाय ज्ञानतृप्तो जितेन्द्रियः। कालाकाक्षी चरँल्लोके ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
en: Or living in this world and renouncing all work, the man of self-control, pleased with all by his wisdom, roams about in the world, waiting for death and annihilating into Brahma.

sa: यत् सुरापं तस्यासीद् वक्त्रं त्रिशिरसस्तदा। कलविङ्काः समुत्पेतुः श्येनाश्च भरतर्षभ।॥
en: And from the mouth of the three-headed one which used to drink wine, came out birds of the Kalavinka species and birds of prey, O best among the race of Bharata.

sa: ऊषुर्महावने तात सिंहव्याघ्रगजाकुले। बाला विहीनाः पित्रा ते मया सततलालिताः॥
en: Live in that great forest, O child, abandoning, as it was, in lions, tigers and elephants. Losing their father in their boyhood, they were even reared and brought up by myself.

sa: संविभक्ता च दाता च भोगवान् सुखवान् नरः। भवत्यहिंसकश्चैव परमारोग्यमश्नुते॥
en: A man who gives every one his due and he who gives boons obtains happiness and every object of enjoyment, while a man who is free from envy reaps perfect ease.

sa: सेनापतिस्त्वहं राजन् समये नापरेण ते। भविष्यामि यथाकामं तन्मे श्रोतुमिहार्हसि॥
en: But there is another condition on which I shall be the leader of your army; that desire which I have in my heart it is proper that you should hear of.

sa: नातः पापीयसी काञ्चिदवस्थां शम्बरोऽब्रवीत्। यत्र नैवाद्य न प्रातर्भोजनं प्रतिदृश्यते॥
en: Shambara was of opinion that there was no condition of life which could be more woeful than that in which a man cannot see what his food is to be tomorrow.

sa: नोत्सहे जीवितुमहं त्वविहीनो नरर्षभ। प्रायोपविष्टस्तु नृप राज्ञां हास्यो भविष्यसि॥
en: O forernost of men, O king, I do not desire to live without you. If you resolve to die by fasting, you will simply be the laughing-stock of all other kings.

sa: सर्वोच्छेदे च यतते वैरस्यान्तविधित्सया। जयो वैरं प्रसृजति दुःखमास्ते पराजितः॥
en: One makes attempts at putting an end to everything through a desire to settle the dispute. Victory gives birth to enmity; and that which has met with defeat lives in misery.

sa: सभायां पश्यतो राज्ञः पातयित्वा पदाहनम्। न चैवालभसे त्राणमभिपन्ना बलीयसा॥
en: I hurled you down in the court and kicked you in the very presence of the king. Having fallen under the grasp of my mighty self you could not obtain deliverance.

sa: नास्मिञ्जनेऽभिरमसे रहः क्षिपसि पाण्डव। नान्यं निशि दिवा चापि कदाचिदभिनन्दसि॥
en: Here you are not pleased with the company of men, but spend your time, O son of Pandu, in solitude; and nothing else ever delights you by day and by night.

sa: यस्याः सागरपर्यन्ता पृथिवी वशवर्तिनी। आसीत् साद्य सुदेष्णाया भीताहं वशवर्तिनी॥
en: Alas! she, who had the entire earth as far as the verge of the sea under her command, is now living in fear of Sudeshna and in subjugation to her. a

sa: यावदाख्याम्यहं चैतत् कृष्णायाक्लिष्टकारिणे। स प्रविश्य सभां वीरः सिंहो गिरिगुहामिव॥
en: In the meantime, I shall communicate all this to Krishna who performs action without exertion. Then that hero, having entered the council like a lion entering the caverns of a mountain,

sa: सुरासुरस्य जगतो गतिस्त्यमसि शूलधृक्। त्वया सर्वमिदं सृष्टं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्॥
en: “O wielder of trident, you are the refuge of the celestials and the Asuras, may of the whole universe. You have created the three worlds with their mobile and immobile creatures.

sa: मनसा तात पर्येति क्रमशो विषयानिमान्। विषयायतनस्थो हि भूतात्मा क्षेत्रमास्थितः॥
en: O my child, the soul moving out of its proper place and assisted by the mind acting through the organs of sense-the recipients of all sensations-gradually perceives all the sensible objects.

sa: सेव्यमानो वरस्त्रीणां चन्द्रात् कान्ततरैर्मुखैः। मेखलानां निनादेन नूपुराणां च निःस्वनैः॥
en: He is served by most beautiful women faces are more charming than the moon. He hears the music of the garlands that encircle their waists and he Nupuras encircling their ankles.

sa: रुद्रेण शुक्रमुत्सृष्टं तच्छ्वेत: पर्वतोऽभवत्। पावकस्येन्द्रियं श्वेते कृत्तिकाभिः कृतं नगे॥
en: The semen ejaculated by Rudra converted in the form of a white mountain. The constalations Krittikas etc. had transmitted the was fire semen at that white mountain made of Rudras semen.

sa: अल्पावशिष्टाः सम्भग्नाः कृच्छ्रप्राणा विचेतसः॥ जिता: संख्ये महाराज युयुधानेन दंशिताः।
en: The handful remnant of those mail-covered soldiers, defeated, O king, by the Satvata hero, became cheerless; and finding their lives on the points of being snatched away from them, they broke.

sa: यदेवमनुजातस्य धातार विदधुः पुरा। तदेवानुचरिष्यामि किं ते मृत्युः करिष्यति॥
en: Before I was born, the ordainers had ordained that I am to do and suffer. I am fulfilling what was thus ordained for me. What then can death do to me.

sa: आदित्यसहितो याति पश्यैनं पुरुषर्षभम्। साध्यानामथ देवानां विश्वेषां मरुतामपि॥ गणेषु पश्य राजेन्द्र वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथान्। सात्यकिप्रमुखान् वीरान् भोजांश्चैव महाबलान्॥
en: He moves in the company of the Sun-God. Behold this foremost of Beings! Among the tribes of the Saddhyas, the celestials, the Vishvedevas, and the Maruts, see, O king of kings, the mighty car-warriors of the Vrishnis and the Andhakas viz., those heroes having Satyaki for their first, and those powerful ones among the Bhojas.

sa: ततस्ते कुलनाशार्थमहं त्वां समुपागतः। चिकीर्षन् कुशिकोच्छेदं संदिधक्षुः कुलं तव॥
en: Hearing this, I came here resolved to exterminate your race. Indeed, I came, O Kushika, seeking the utter extermination of your family, in fact, for reducing to ashes all your descendants.

sa: विस्तरेणैतदिच्छामि कथ्यमानं त्वया द्विजा मूलं ह्येतद् विनाशस्य पृथिव्या द्विजसत्तम॥
en: O sinless one, O foremost of the twice borne. I desire to hear narrated by you in detail all this which became the cause of the destruction of all the world.

sa: तं शब्दं तुमुलं श्रुत्वा द्रोणो यन्तारमब्रवीत्। क्रुद्धः सात्वतानां महारथः॥
en: "O charioteer this mighty car-warrior, of the Satvata race inflamed with wrath, has shattered the host in many places and is now careering like the Destroyer in the field of battle.

sa: छादयामि जगद् विश्वं भूत्वा सूर्य इवांशुभिः। सर्वभूताधिवासश्च वासुदेवस्ततो ह्यहम्॥
en: Taking the form of the Sun I cover the universe, with my rays. And because I am the home of all creatures, therefore, am I called by the name of Vasudeva.

sa: स ते जीवितशेषस्य राघवोऽन्तकरो बली। पशोडूंपगतस्येव जीवितं तव दुर्लभम्॥
en: The strong Rāghava will compass the end of what remains of your life. Like the life of a beast tied to the sacrificial stake, your own is incapable of being reclaimed.

sa: पतिशुश्रूषया यन्मे तपः किंचिदुपार्जितम्। तेन त्वां दुरवापेन शप्स्ये चक्रगदाधर॥
en: By the little merit I have acquired by serving dutifully by husband, by that merit so, difficult to attain, I shall curse you, O holder of the discus and the race.

sa: अभिधावंस्ततो वाक्यमन्तरिक्षात् स शुश्रुवे। किमासीदसि पानीयं तच्छक्यं बलात् त्वया।॥
en: And as he rushed (towards the water) he heard these words from the firmament “Why are you coming towards the water You will not। be able to drink of it forcibly.

sa: तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण जपहोमैस्तथौषधैः। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Is it by penances, or celibacy or silent recitation of sacred Mantras, or drugs? Is it by his deeds, or mind, or speech? Do you explain to me this, O grandfather.

sa: जवे प्रहारे सम्म सर्व एवातिमानुषाः। सर्वैर्जिता महीपाला दिग्जये भरतर्षभ॥
en: In impetuosity, in striking and crushing all of them are superhuman and by them by all the rulers of the earth had been vanquished at the time of the universal conquest.

sa: आलम्बमाना सहितावूरू गजकरोपमौ। पपात सहसा भूमौ वेपन्ती कदली यथा॥
en: Thus trying to support herself with her thighs which were like the trunk of an elephant, she suddenly fell down on the ground, trembling like a plantain tree stirred (by wind).

sa: बभूव विमनाः पार्थो दैवमित्यनुचिन्तयन्। न्यवर्तत ततो राजन् नेदमस्तीति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Considering it all as the work of destiny, he became greatly cheerless. He then ceased, O king, to make further efforts, saying, he had not the power which he had before.

sa: पितामहस्य वदतः पुरा देवसमागमे। श्रुतवानस्मि यद् राजस्तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥
en: In days of yore, on one occasion, when the deities had assembled together, the Grandfather Brahman said some words. I heard them, O king, and shall now repeat them to you.

sa: न तत्र काश्चित् प्रमदाः प्रसह्य वीर्योपपन्नेन गुणेन लब्धाः। न चान्यकामापि न चान्यपूर्वा विना वराहाँ जनकात्मजां तु।७०।।
en: There was no woman there, who had been won by force by (Rāvana), possessed as he was of prowess; but they had all been subdued by his qualities. And save the surpassingly worthy daughter of Janaka, no female (had been brought), who had set her heart on another, or who had known any other before.

sa: देवलोकं ब्रह्मलोकं संचरन् पुण्यकृद् वशी। अवसत् पृथिवीपालो दीर्घकालमिति श्रुतिः॥
en: That doer of pious acts (Yayati) often went from the region of the celestials to the region of Brahma. It is heard that he lived in heaven for a long time.

sa: त्वत्तः कुलहितं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा राज्यहितोदयम्। अमृतस्याव्ययस्येव तृप्तः स्वप्स्याम्यहं सुखम्॥
en: Hearing instructions from you which are productive of good to our family and kingdom, I shall be able to live happily like a person pleased with having drunk the immortal nectar.

sa: धर्मस्य जानमानोऽहं गतिमवयां सुदुर्विदाम्। कथं बलात् करिष्यामि मेरोरिव विमर्दनम्॥
en: Knowing as I do the true course of Dharma, which is so difficult to be known, how can I forcibly grind it, which would be like my grinding the Meru (mountain)."

sa: तत्र चापि नरव्याघ्र मनो जन्तोर्विधीयते। तस्माद् युगपदत्रास्य ग्रहणं नोपपद्यते॥
en: O the most exalted of men the mind of creatures is the cause of all perceptions; and therefore it cannot at one and the same time perceive a plurality of objects,

sa: एकाक्षो जाज्वलनास्ते सर्वतोऽक्षिमयोऽपि वा। क्रोधाद् यश्चाविशल्लोकांस्तस्मात् सर्व इति स्मृतः॥
en: With one of his eyes blazing forth, he appears to have eyes on all sides of his body; and as in his wrath, he possesses the worlds, he is called Sarva.

sa: द्विविधं त्रिविधोपायमुपायमपि सेवते। विजिगीषुः सुहृत् कच्चिन्मित्रेषु च परंतपः॥ "
en: Is that slayer of foes, desirous of acquiring victory, pleasing his friends still with forgiveness and gifts and dealing his enemies with punishment, sowing dassensions among them, and with other expedients?

sa: वढेरिव प्रदीप्तस्य वने शुष्कतृणोलपे। पश्य पाण्डवमुख्येन यातां भूमि किरीटिना॥
en: For a raging forests conflagration shrinks not at the sight of numerous heaps of dried grass. Behold the ground through which the diadem-decked Arjuna, that best of the Pandavas has passed.

sa: ऋतुपर्णस्ततो राजा बाहुकं कार्यगौरवात्। हयज्ञानस्य लोभाच्च तं तथेत्यब्रवीद् वचः॥
en: Thereupon king Rituparna, for the reason of the great importance of his business and also for his extreme desire to acquire the knowledge of horses, agreed to what Bahuka had said.

sa: प्रलब्धश्च हृषीकेशस्तच कर्माविचारितम्। स च मे वचनं ब्रह्मन् कथमेवाभिमन्यते॥
en: The princess Krishna, while standing in the midst of the assembly, wept piteously. Krishna will never forget that act of ours, nor, the deprivation of Yudhishthira by us of his kingdom.

sa: असंभाव्यं वधं तस्य वृत्रस्य विबुधाधिपः। चिन्तयानो जगामाशु लोकस्यान्तं महायशाः॥
en: There upon thinking that he has perpetrated an iniquity by slaying Vịtra engaged in asceticism, Indra, out of fear, fled to the other side of Lokāloka mountain, perpetually enshrouded with darkness.

sa: घटमाना मदर्थेऽस्मिन् हताः शूरा जनाधिपाः। शेरते लोहिताक्ताङ्गा संग्रामे शरविक्षतः॥
en: Many brave kings, who tried their best for me in this battle, have been killed. Wounded with shafts and their limbs bathed in blood, they lie now on the nacked Earth.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अनार्यमार्येण सहस्रनेत्र शक्यं कर्तुं दुष्करमेतदार्य। मा मे श्रिया सङ्गमनं तयास्तु यस्याः कृते भक्तजनं त्यजेयम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O you of a thousand eyes, O you, who ere of righteous conduct, it is extremely difficult for one that is of righteous conduct to perpetrate an act which is unrighteous. I do not with that union with prosperity for which I shall have to cast off one that is devoted to me.

sa: पुरा कृतयुगे राजन्ब्राह्मणा वै तपस्विनः।।।। अब्राह्मणस्तदा राजन्न तपस्वी कथंचन।
en: O king, in the golden age, only the Brahmanas used to engage in asceticism. At that age save the Brāhmaṇas no other caste used to lead the life of an anchoret.

sa: द्वैपायनं नारदं च मार्कण्डेयं तपोधनम्। भारद्वाजं याज्ञवल्क्यं हरिमुद्दिश्य यत्नवान्॥
en: The king, in honour of Hari, and naming him repeatedly, fed the Dvaipayana Vyasa, and Narada, and Markandeya having penances for wealth, and Yajnavalkya of Bharadvaja race, with many delicious food.

sa: एवं सप्तदशं देहे वृतं षोडशभिर्गुणैः। मनीषी मनसा विप्रः पश्यत्यात्मानमात्मनि॥
en: The wise man, capable of controlling his senses, sees the seventeenth, viz., the Soul as surrounded by six and ten qualities, in his own Understanding by the help of the mind.

sa: ऊर्ध्वं प्राणा ह्युत्क्रामन्ति यूनः स्थविर आयति॥ प्रत्युत्थानाभिवादाभ्यां पुनस्तान् प्रतिपद्यते।
en: The lifebreaths of a young man go up wards, when an old and venerable person comes to his house. He gets them back by standing up and properly saluting the guest.

sa: स त्रैलोक्यविनाशाय कोपाग्निं जनयिष्यति। महीं सपर्वतवनां यः करिष्यति भस्मसात्॥
en: He will cherish such anger as will be sufficient to consume the three worlds. He will be competent to reduce the whole Earth with all her mountains and forests into ashes.

sa: अथादृश्यत धर्मात्मा भृगुश्रेष्ठो महातपाः। आह्वयामास च तदा युद्धाय द्विजसत्तमः॥
en: Then did the great devotee of virtuous soul, the foremost of the race of Bhrigu present himself to his view and that best among the twice born summoned him to fight.

sa: अथैनमभ्युपागम्य वायुर्वाक्यमुवाच ह॥ ब्रह्मदत्तवरो ह्येष अवध्यकवचावृतः। ब्राह्मणास्त्रेण भिन्ध्येनमेष वध्यो हि नान्यथा।। अवध्य एष ह्यन्येषामस्त्राणां कवची बली॥
en: Then approaching him, the wind-god spoke to him, saying, "This one has received a boon from Brahmā, and is covered with an impenetrable mail. Pierce him with a Brahma* weapon. He cannot otherwise be slain. This one clad in mail and endowed with prowess is forsooth incapable of being slain by others." *Belonging to Brahma.

sa: वाहनानि च यानानि योगात्मनि तपोधने। अग्नीनुपश्यानस्य राज्ञः पौरुषमेव च॥
en: One possessed of penances and having his soul on Yoga, gets vehicles and riding animals. The king who lics down by the side of the sacrificial fire, acquires vigour and valour.

sa: पातिते भीमसेनेन शल्ये कर्णे च शरूिते। शरूिताः सर्वराजानः परिवर्तृकोदरम्॥
en: When Shalya was thus thrown down by Bhima and Karna was struck with fear, all the other kings were filled with awe and they surrounded Vrikodara (Bhima from all sides), of

sa: बबन्ध कक्षां कौन्तेयस्ततः संहर्षयञ्जनम्। ततस्तु वृत्रसंकाशं भीमो मल्लं समाह्वयत्॥
en: Then Bhima, the son of Kunti, girded up his lions and caused the delight of the spectators. There he summoned the wrestler of distinguished prowess named Jimuta resembling Vritra himself. were

sa: शान्तिरेवं भवेद् राजन् प्रीतिश्चैव परस्परम्। राज्यैकदेशमपि नः प्रयच्छ शममिच्छताम्॥
en: By this means, O king, there shall be peace and good will among each other; give back to us, who are desirous of peace, even one province out of the kingdom.

sa: मामेव यजतां शक्रः पावयिष्यामि वज्रिणम्। पुण्येन हयमेधेन मामिष्ट्वा पाकशासनः॥
en: "Let Shakra offer sacrifice to me, I shall purity the one with the thunderbolt. Having duly worshipped me, by the holy sacrifice of a horse, shall the chastiser of the Paka.

sa: अभ्यग्रं च प्रपश्यन्ति युद्धमानन्दिनो द्विजाः। क्रव्यादा भक्षयिष्यन्ति मांसानि गजवाजिनाम्॥
en: These birds, becoming exceedingly glad at the prospect of the battle, are loO king down on the field of battle. Carnivorous beasts will feast on the flesh of elephants and horses.

sa: प्राप्य दु:खं वनेश्यामा मां मन्मथविकर्शितम्। नष्टदु:खेव हृष्टेव साध्वी साध्वभ्यभाषत॥
en: Thai chaste and exquisitely fine damsel even when afflicted in the woods used to welcome me under the influence of Cupid as if she were delighted and had her sorrows removed.

sa: ऋषिस्तथा गालवोऽथाष्टकश्च भरद्वाजोऽरुन्धती बालखिल्याः। शिबिर्दिलीपो नहुषोऽम्बरीषो राजा ययातिधुंधुमारोऽथ पूरुः॥
en: There were also the Rishi Galava, and Ashtaka and Bharadvaja and Arundhati and the Valakhilyas, and Shibi and Dilipa and Nahusha and Ambarisha and the royal Yayati and Dhundhumara and Puru.

sa: सर्वे त्वतिरथाः शूराः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः। सर्वे वेदविदश्चैव सर्वे सर्वास्त्रकोविदाः॥
en: They were all heroes and Atirathas, they were all learned in the science of war. They were all well acquainted with the Vedas and experts in using all kinds of weapons.

sa: तत्रासीत् पिङ्गलो गाय॑स्त्रिजटो नाम वै द्विजः। क्षतवृत्तिर्वने नित्यं फालकुद्दाललाङ्गली॥
en: There lived in that quarter a Brāhmaṇa of a tawny colour, by name Trijata, descended from the line of Garga, earning his live-hood by digging the earth with spades and ploughs.

sa: यथा यज्ञे महानग्निमन्त्रपूतः प्रकाशवान्। तथा दुर्योधनो राजा संग्रामे सर्वतोऽभवत्॥
en: With strong determination your powerful son stood in battle. even as blazing and mighty fire on the sacrificial platform purified with mantras, king Duryodhana moved in the field, in that battle.

sa: असम्भाष्या भवन्त्येते पितॄणां नात्र संशयः। देवताः पितरश्चैषां नाभिनन्दन्ति तद्धविः॥
en: Forsooth, the departed Manes of such people cut them off without wishing to have any intercourse with them. The offerings they make fail to please the celestials and the departed Manes.

sa: न लुब्धो बुध्यते दोषाँ ल्लोभान्मोहात् प्रवर्तते। मधुलिप्सुर्हि नापश्यं प्रपातमहमीदृशम्॥
en: A covetous man never finds his own shortcomings; and it is from folly, that covetousness proceeds. Desirous of collecting the honey, I could not see that such a fall threatened me.

sa: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्। विराज्य सशरं चापं मूर्च्छयाभिपरिप्लुतः॥
en: Thus deeply pierced and extremely pained, the latter squatted down on the terrace of his car; and he lost hold of his arrows and bow and was overwhelmed with a swoon.

sa: उन्मत्तमिव चापि त्वां प्रहसन्तीह दुःखितम्। विलपन्तं बहुविधं भीतं परविकत्थने॥
en: In this case they laugh at you, who are grieved and like one insane and giving vent to many sorts of lamentations, struck with fear by the descriptions of the enemies.

sa: मम भार्या जनस्थानादज्ञानाद्राक्षसाधम। हृता ते विवशा यस्मात्तस्मात्त्वं नासि वीर्यवान्॥
en: You vile of Räkşasas, in consequence of having through lack of sense carried off my wife from Janasthana and brought her under your subjection, you have been deprived of your prowess.

sa: मदोऽष्टादशदोषः स स्यात् पुरा योऽप्रकीर्तितः। लोकद्वेष्यं प्रातिकूल्यमभ्यसूया मृषा वचः॥
en: Mada has eighteen vices which have not before been described. (They are) hatred towards men, acting against the interests of others, speaking ill of others who do not deserve it, untruthfulness,

sa: ततः प्रावर्तत नदी घोररूपा रणाजिरे। शूराणां हर्षजननी भीरूणां भयवर्धिनी॥
en: Then on the field of battle a terrible river started up into existence and began to flow there adding to the joy of heroes and to the feat of the cowards.

sa: योधास्तत्र महाराज समासाद्य परस्परम्। व्यचरन्त रणे क्रुद्धा विनिघ्नन्तः परस्परम्॥
en: Soon the field was covered with heads, beautiful as the filaments of the lotus, bedecked with ear-rings and having faces set with eyes upturned in wrath and lips bit in rage.

sa: अहमिष्टिं करिष्यामि पुत्रार्थं ते विशाम्पते। वीतहव्यसहस्राणि येन त्वं प्रहरिष्यसि॥
en: son on I shall perform a sacrifice, O monarch, in order that you may have a son through whom you will be able to smite thousand upon thousands of Vitahavya's party.

sa: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि। ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी॥
en: This enemy of mine has been killed by me, I shall kill other enemies also, I am the lord, I am the enjoyed, I am successful, I am powerful and happy.

sa: संहताश्च भृशं ह्येते अन्योन्यस्य हितैषिणः। अक्षौहिण्यश्च संरब्धा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य भारत॥
en: They are arranged in serried file and are resolved to stand firmly by one another. These Akshauhini of troops belonging to the sons of Dhritarashtra, all inspired with rage. as are

sa: अथोपोष्य शिर:स्नाता देवतामभिगम्य सा। हुत्वाग्नि विधिवद् विप्रान् वाचयामास पर्वणि॥
en: Then on a Parva day, Savitri, observing fasts, bathing her head and approaching the family deity caused the Brahmanas to offer oblations to the sacrificial fire in accordance with due rites.

sa: वारुणश्च महाशङ्खो देवदत्त: सुघोषवान्। सर्वमेतत् प्रदास्यामि भवते नात्र संशयः॥
en: (There is also in that lake) a large conchshell of loud sound, named Devadatta which was produced by Varuna (Ocean). There is no doubt I shall give all these to you."

sa: तवैव वंशे सगरो ज्येष्ठपुत्रमुपारुधत्। असमञ्ज इति ख्यातं तथायं गन्तुमर्हति॥
en: Even in this line of yours, Sagara deprived his eldest son Asamañja by name of the enjoyment of the kingdom. In this way this one deserves to go to the forest.

sa: तमागतं प्रेक्ष्य तदातिकायो बाणं प्रदीप्तान्तककालकल्पम्। जघान शक्त्यष्टिगदाकुठारैः शूलैः शरश्चाप्यविपनचेष्टः॥
en: Seeing that shaft flaming and resembling the Fatal destroyer himself, coming, he, exerting himself to the utmost resisted it with darts and Rştis and maces and adzes and javelins and arrows.

sa: स वायुवीर्यप्रतिमो वायुवेगसमो जवे। वायुवद् व्यचरद् भीमो वायुपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Bhima, the son of the Wind-god and himself possessing the prowess and impetuousity of the wind, that valiant Bhima began to career in that battle like that of the wind itself.

sa: एष शेते रथोपस्थे कृपो मद्बाणपीडितः। अकामयानेन मया विशिखैरर्दितो भृशम्॥
en: Such a one lies (insensible) on the terrace of his car smitten with my darts. Although I did not wish it, (still), through me he has been crushed with the arrows.

sa: न कश्चित्कस्यचिच्छ्रोता न कश्चित्कस्यचिद् गुरुः। तमोग्रस्तस्तदा लोको भविष्यति जनाधिप।॥
en: O ruler of men, no one will listen to the words of others and none will be considered as another's preceptor. The whole world will be enveloped by fearful (intellectual) darkness.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महेष्वासो भूय एव महाबलः। सात्वतं पीडयामास शरेणानतपर्वणा॥
en: Then again excited to the highest pitch of fury, that fierce bowman endued with great might, once more began to afflict him of the Satvata race, with arrows of depressed knots.

sa: तत्र चामिषलुब्धेन लुब्धकेन महावने। अविदूरे मृगान् दृष्ट्वा बाणः प्रतिसमाहितः॥
en: Desirous of getting meat, when in a big forest in pursuit of the chase, he saw a drove of antelopes near at hand, and shot his arrow at one of them.

sa: जनमेजय उवाय तथा व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु कुरुक्षेत्रे द्विजर्षभ। किमकुर्वश्च कुरवः कालेनाभिप्रचोदिताः॥
en: Janamejaya said The army having then been prepared in order for battle, O best among the Bharatas, what did the sons of Kuru, urged as they were by destiny itself, do?

sa: तत: संख्यातुमारब्धमदशद् दशमे पदे। तस्य दष्टस्य तद् रूपं क्षिप्रमन्तरधीयत॥
en: Thereupon the king commenced counting his own steps, and at the tenth step he was bit. Having thus bitten him, the snake soon assumed a speedy change, viz., his original form.

sa: पानीयदा ह्यतृषिताः प्रहृष्टमनसो नराः। पन्थानं द्योतयन्तश्च यान्ति दीपप्रदाः सुखम्॥
en: Those that have given king go along with cheerful hearts without ever being afflicted by thirst. Those that have given lights go along in great happiness lighting the way before them.

sa: द्विगुणीकृततेजा हि प्रज्वलन्निव पावकः। उत्सङ्गे धनुरादाय सशरं रथिनां वरः॥
en: Taking upon his shoulder his bow and arrows that best of car-warriors, covered in mail and adorned with ornaments, made the twice-born perform the rites of propitiation on his behalf. ones

sa: अतिप्रमाणा बलिनो दीप्तजिह्वा महाविषाः। निपीडितशिरोग्रीवा व्यवेष्टन्त महाहयः॥
en: And exceedingly powerful and mighty snakes of virulent venom, having flaming tongues, with their hoods and necks tortured, began to roll (on the earth).

sa: तस्य पक्षप्रपक्षेभ्यो निष्पतन्ति युयुत्सवः। पत्यश्वरतमातङ्गाः प्रावृषीव बलाहकाः॥
en: Like the continual clouds of the rainy season, the infantry, cavalry, car-warriors and elephants, desirous of battle, began to issue from all the wings.

sa: कुम्भकर्णभुजाभ्यां तु पीडितो वानरर्षभः। निपपातर्षभो भीमः प्रमुखागतशोणितः॥
en: Agonised on being fastened with Kumbhakarma's arms, that foremost of monkeys, the dreadful Rşabha, fell down to the earth, vomiting blood by his mouth.

sa: रथिनश्च स्थैींना वर्मिणस्तेजसा युताः। कुण्डलोष्णीषिणः सर्वे निष्काङ्गदविभूषणाः॥
en: Many car-warriors deprived of their cars, clad in armour and possessed of strength all decked with ear-rings and turbans and with bracelets and garlands,

sa: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा। कच्चिदज्ञानसम्मोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनंजय॥
en: Have you heard, O Partha, this knowledge with mind undirected to any other object? Has, O Dhananjaya, your delusion, caused by ignorance, been destroyed?

sa: तिलपात्रे फलं प्राह भगवान् पाकशासनः। गोप्रदानं च यः कुर्याद् भूमिदानं च शाश्वतम्॥ अग्निष्टोमं च यो यज्ञं यजेत बहुदक्षिणम्। तिलपात्रं सहैतेन समं मन्यन्ति देवताः॥
en: The divine chastiser of Paka has attributed these merits to the gift of vessels of copper and brass filled with sesame seeds. He who makes gifts of kine, he who makes gifts of land which yield eternal merit, he who performs the Agnishthoma sacrifice with profuse presents in the form of Dakshina to the Brahmanas are all considered by the celestials as acquiring merits equal to those which one acquires by making gifts of vessels filled with sesame seeds.

sa: खरस्तु तन्महत्सैन्यं रथचर्मायुधध्वजम्। निर्यातेत्यब्रवीत् प्रेक्ष्य दूषणः सर्वराक्षसान्॥
en: Beholding that mighty army consisting of cars and arms and pennons, Khara as well as Dūşana, said to that multitude of Rākşasas, March forth!

sa: कबन्धान्तर्हितो भानुरुदयास्तमने तदा। अकालवर्षी भगवान् भविष्यति सहस्रदृक्॥
en: The sun from his rising to setting will be covered by Rahu. The exalted deity of one thousand eyes (Indra) will unceasingly shower rains,

sa: युगन्धरस्ततो राजन् भारद्वाजं महारथम्। वारयामास संक्रुद्धं वातोद्धतमिवार्णवम्॥
en: Thereupon, 0 monarch, Yugandhara opposed the mighty car-warrior, the son of Bharadvaja, who was inflamed with rage like the ocean swelling with the tempest.

sa: सात्वतेन च बाणौधैर्निर्विद्धस्तनयस्तव। शातकुंभमयापीडो बभौ यूप इवोच्छ्रितः॥
en: r'ierced with myriads of shafts by him of the Satvata race, your son appeared beautiful like a golden stake set up at a sacrifice.

sa: तस्योरुवेगोन्मथिताः पादपाः पुष्पशालिनः। निपेतुर्भूतले भग्नाः शक्रायुधहता इव॥
en: And borne down by the violence of his thighs, trees bearing flowers, being shattered, as if destroyed by Sakra's weapon, fell to the ground.

sa: तत्र जाम्बूनदाङ्गानि स्पर्ध्यास्तरणवन्ति च। मणिविदुमचित्राणि ज्वलिताग्निप्रभाणि च॥ भेजिरे पुरुषव्याघ्रा वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथाः। सिंहासनानि शतशो धिष्ण्यानीव हुताशनाः॥
en: Like blazing fires taking faggots to increase their splendour, those best of men, the great car-warriors of the Vrishni and the Andhaka races, possessing the lustre of the blazing fire, took their seats on thousands of golden thrones, covered with excellent carpets and adorned with gems and corals.

sa: पृष्ठतोऽनुगमिष्यामि त्वामहं सहसैनिकः। सात्यकिं मोक्षयस्वाद्य यमदंष्ट्रान्तरं गतम्॥
en: Supported by my divisions, I will follow behind you. Do you all rescue Satyaki today who is now within the very teeth of death."

sa: नीयते यमदूतैस्तु यमस्याज्ञाकरैर्बलात्॥ नराः स्त्रियस्तथैवान्ये पृथिव्यां जीवसंज्ञिताः।
en: Along this path are forcibly taken by messenger of Yama, obedient to his command, all men and women and all creatures that have life.

sa: ब्राह्मणैस्तु प्रतिच्छन्नौ रौरवाजिनवासिभिः। कृच्छ्रेण जग्मतुस्तौ तु भीमसेनधनंजयौ॥
en: Surrounded by Brahmanas attired in skins of deed and other wild animals, Bhima and Dhananjaya passed through the crowd with good deal of difficulty.

sa: अद्यार्जुनं सगोविन्दं मानिनं च वृकोदरम्॥ निहत्य शिष्टाशत्रूश्च कर्णस्यानृण्यमाप्नुयाम्। तच्छ्रुत्वा कुरुराजस्य शूरार्यसदृशं वचः॥ सूतो हेमपरिच्छन्नाशनैरश्वानचोदयत्।
en: Today, killing Arjuna with Govinda and the proud Vrikodara and the rest of my enemies. I will free myself from the debt I owe to Karna.”—Hearing these words of the Kuru king worthy of an honorable man, his driver slowly urged those horse adorned with trappings of gold.

sa: नीचस्य क्षुद्रशीलस्य मिथ्यावृत्तस्य रक्षसः। प्राणानपहरिष्यामि गरुत्मानमृतं यथा॥
en: As Garuda stole ambrosia, will I deprive you, O Rāksasa, who are base, of a mean disposition and a false character, of your life.

sa: तेषु यज्ञेष्वम्बरीषो दक्षिणामत्यकालयत्। राज्ञां शतसहस्राणि दश प्रयुतयाजिनाम्॥
en: In those sacrifices, Ambarisha gave as gifts the kingdoms of hundreds and thousands of kings to the ten million priests engaged in his sacrifice.

sa: ते नैतन्नाभिनन्दन्ति पञ्चविंशकमच्युतम्। जन्ममृत्युभयाद् योगाः सांख्याश्च परमैषिणः॥
en: Frightened at repeated births and deaths, the Sankhyas and Yogins consider the Individual Soul and the Supreme Soul to be one and the same.

sa: तथा त्वमपि कल्याणि ब्राह्मणात्तपसाधिकात्। मन्नियोगाद्यत क्षिप्रमपत्योत्पादनं प्रति॥
en: O greatly fortunate lady, like her you too at my command raise offspring by some Brahmana who is superior to me in ascetic merits.

sa: न चाहं कंचिदत्यर्थमपराधमरिंदम। विचिन्तयन् प्रपश्यामि सुसूक्ष्ममपि केशव॥
en: I have not committed the slightest fault, O chastiser of foes, nor do I see any after a most minute and searching examination, OKeshava.

sa: ततोऽस्यापततः शूराः सहदेवः प्रतापवान्॥ उलूकस्य महाराज भल्लेनापाहरच्छिरः।
en: The heroic and brave Sahadeva then, O king, cut off, with a broad-headed arrow, the head of Uluka as the latter proceeded against him.

sa: महामारुतवेगेन समुद्रमिव पर्वसु। धार्तराष्ट्रबलं तात विक्षिप्तं सव्यसाचिना॥
en: Like the very ocean in a Parva day agitated by a mighty tempest, the army of Dhritarashtra, O sire, is being agitated by Savyasachin.

sa: त्रयोदशद्वीपवतीं गोभिर्भासयसे महीम्। त्रयाणामपि लोकानां हितायैकः प्रवर्तसे॥
en: You illuminate by your rays the whole earth with her thirteen islands. You alone are (ever) engaged in doing good to the three worlds.

sa: जातकाद्याः क्रियाश्चास्या विधिपूर्वं यथाक्रमम्। स्थूलकेशो महाभागश्चकार सुमहानृषिः॥
en: The great Rishi, the blessed Sthulakesha, performed for her in succession all the ceremonies with that of her birth, as ordained in the Shastras.

sa: अस्माकं पुरुषव्याघ्र मित्रमन्यन्न विद्यते॥ परमन्धकवृष्णिभ्यः पञ्चालेभ्यश्च मारिष।
en: O foremost of men, we possess not friends dearer to ourselves, then the Andhakas, the Vrishnis and the Panchalas, O descendant of Madhu's race.

sa: मनूनां मनुपुत्राणां जगतोऽमानवस्य च। मन्वन्तराणां सर्वेषामीश्वराणां त्वमीश्वरः॥
en: You are the lord of the Manus, of the sons of Manus, of the universe, of mankind, of the Manvantaras and of all lords.

sa: प्रशाम्यमाने शैनेय सहदेवेन मारिष॥ पाञ्चालराजस्य सुतः प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत्।
en: When, O sire, Sahadeva was thus pacifying the grandson of Shini, the son of the Panchala king thus smilingly spoke:मुञ्चमुञ्च शिनेः पौत्रं भीम युद्धमदान्वितम्॥

sa: श्लेष्मादिभिर्व्याप्ततनुम्रियमाणो विचेतनः। ब्राह्मणा एव सम्पूज्याः पुण्यं स्वर्गमभीप्सता।१६।।
en: Even if your body be dull and weak and full of phlegm. He who desires to obtain virtue and heaven should worship the Brahmanas.

sa: विदितं भवतो वीर्यं माहात्म्यं वेद आगमे। कुरुष्वेह यथाशान्ति ब्रह्मा शरणमस्तु ते॥ तद् वै पारत्रिकं तात ब्राह्मणानामकुप्यताम्। अथवा तप्यसे पापे धर्ममेवानुपश्य वै॥
en: You know the energy and the nobility of the Brahmana as laid down in the Veda and other scriptures. Act now in such a way that you may have tranquillity of heart and let Brahmanas be your refuge. If the Brahmanas do not be angry with you, you will, forsooth, enjoy happiness in heaven. If, again, you repent for sins, your sight will be clear and you will succeed in seeing righteousness.

sa: तस्मात् सर्वास्ववस्थासु सर्वदानानि पार्थिव दातव्यानि द्विजातिभ्यः स्वर्गमार्गजिगीषया॥
en: O king, therefore, the man who desires to get to the path of heaven should under all conditions give away (wealth) to the Brahmanas.

sa: जन्त्येते पार्थिवान् वीराः पाण्डवाः समभिद्रुताः। नागाश्वरथपत्योघांस्तावकान् समभिघ्नतः॥
en: Coming forward the heroic Pandavas are killing the kings, a good many elephants, horses, car-warriors and foot soldiers of your army engaged in battle.

sa: ततस्तु स्तुवतां तेषां सूतानां पाणिवादकाः। अपदानान्युदाहृत्य पाणिवादान्यवादयन्॥
en: And as the bards hymned the monarch, palmplayers celebrating the deeds of the kings of the Raghu race, began to play with their palms.

sa: ततस्तौ रथिनां श्रेष्ठौ सर्वलोकधनुर्धरौ। शैनेयप्रमुखान् पार्थानभिदुदुवतू रणे॥
en: Then those two foremost of car-warriors, the best of all human bowmen, rushed against the Parthas headed by the grandson of Shini and others.

sa: क्षत्ता व्ययकरस्त्वासीद् विदुरः सर्वधर्मावेत्। दुर्योधनस्त्वर्हणानि प्रतिजग्राह सर्वशः॥
en: Kshatta (Vidura), learned in all the precepts of virtue, became the master of exchequer. Duryodhana became the receiver of tributes brought by the kings.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजानमारुरोह दिवं पुनः। उशीनरोऽपिधर्मात्माधर्मेणावृत्य रोदसी॥ विभ्राजमानो वपुषाप्यारुरोह त्रिविष्टपम्। तदेतत् सदनं राजन् राज्ञस्तस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Lomasha said: Having said this to the king, he (Indra) again went to heaven. And the virtuous Ushinara also, after filling heaven and earth with the merit of his pious deeds, went to heaven in an effulgent form. O king, yonder is the residence of that illustrious king.

sa: असहन्तोऽभियानं तच्छाल्वराजस्य कौरव। चारुदेष्णश्च साम्बश्च प्रद्युम्नश्च महारथः॥ ते रथैर्दशिताः सर्वे विचित्राभरणध्वजाः। संसक्ताः शाल्वराजस्य बहुभिर्योधपुङ्गवैः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, without being able to bear the pride of king Shalva, Charudeshna, Samba and the great car-warrior, Pradyumna. Clad in armour and adorned with ornaments with color flying, sallied out on their chariots, with the desire of meeting the numerous great warriors of king Shalva.

sa: विपरीतश्च लोकोऽयं भविष्यत्यधरोत्तरः। एडूकान् पूजयिष्यन्ति वर्जयिष्यन्ति देवताः॥
en: The low will become the high and all sources of things will appear in contrary shape. Abandoning the celestials, men will worship the bones.

sa: अयं सरथ आयातः श्वेताश्वः कृष्णसारथिः। दुर्वारः सर्वसैन्यानां विपाकः कर्मणामिव॥ निघ्नन्नमित्रान् कौन्तैयो यं कर्ण परिपृच्छसि।
en: There comes the car drawn by white horses and having Krishna as its driver, the car which even all the soldiers cannot resist as the fruit follows the work. There comes the son of Kunti slaying all his foes along the way, he of whom you were inquiring.

sa: बलवन्तः समृद्धार्था मित्रबान्धवनन्दनाः। जीवन्त्यन्योन्याश्रित्य दुमाः काननजा इव॥
en: Being powerful, growing in prosperity and making their friends and relatives happy, they live depending on one another like the trees of the forest.

sa: प्रज्ञावन्तौ नरश्रेष्ठावस्मॅिल्लोके नराधिप। त्वन्निमित्तपतो नेमौ किंचिज्जिा वदिष्यतः॥
en: O king, these foremost of men are endued with wisdom; they will never give you evil advises or say any thing that is crooked.

sa: निश्चित्य बहुधैवं स सात्यकियुद्धदुर्मदः। धर्मराजमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीत् पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Thus thinking over the matter in various ways, that foremost of men, the invincible Satyaki, spoke these words to the very virtuous king Yudhishthira.

sa: गच्छतस्तस्य वेगेन तार्क्ष्यमारुतरंहसः। भीमस्य पाण्डुपुत्राणां मूछेव समजायत।॥
en: So great was the force with which Bhima, endued with the speed of Garuda or Maruta, proceeded that the Pandavas seemed to be fainted.

sa: भृकुटीकृतदुष्प्रेक्ष्यमभवत् तस्य तन्मुखम्। युगान्तकाले सम्प्राप्ते कृतान्तस्येव रूपिणः॥
en: His face became terrible to look at in consequence of his furrowed brows as that of Yama himself at the time of universal destruction.

sa: तावुपारोप्य दाशार्हः स्यन्दनं लोकपूजितम्। प्रतोदेन जवोपेतान् परमाश्चानचोदयत्॥
en: Making them got on that car of his which was adored by all the world, the Dasharha hero urged those best of fleet horses.

sa: निवृत्तपितृकार्यं च निर्वषट्कारमङ्गलम्। जगत् प्रतिभयाकारं दुष्प्रेक्ष्यमभवत् तदा॥
en: The ceremonies in honour of the Pitris, the sacred sound of Vashata (Vedas) and all auspicious rites ceased. The universe looked frightful to behold.

sa: ऋक्षं धूमिन्यथो नीली दुष्यन्तपरमेष्ठिनौ। केशिन्यजनयजह्ल सुतौ व्रजनरूपिणौ॥
en: Riksha was born in the womb of Dhumini, Dushyanta and Parameshti in that of Nili and Jahnu, Jala and Rupina in that of Keshini.

sa: ततः समागतान्सर्वान्स्थाप्य लोकगुरुर्दिवि। हृष्टैः प्रमुदितैर्देवैर्जगाम त्रिदिवं महत्॥
en: Having thus settled in heaven all those arrived there the father, of creatures with the deities, delighted and happy, repaired to the highest heaven.

sa: कृतस्वस्त्ययनो राजा ब्राह्मणेन यशस्विना। समनह्यज्जरासंधः क्षात्रं धर्ममनुस्मरन्॥
en: The king's propitiatory ceremonies with benedictions having been performed by an illustrious Brahmana, Jarasandha, remembering the duty of a Kshatriya, dressed himself for battle.

sa: श्रद्दधानः सदायुक्तः सदा धर्मपरायणः। आसेवन्निममध्यायं नरः पापात्प्रमुच्यते॥
en: The man of faith, ever devoted, ever employed in the exercise of virtue, is freed from sin on reading this chapter, of the Bharata.

sa: सुचन्द्रं चन्द्रहर्तारं तथा चन्द्रप्रमर्दनम्। क्रूरस्वभावं क्रूरायाः पुत्रपौत्रमनन्तकम्॥
en: And (she gave birth to) three others, namely Suchandra, Chandraharta and Chandrapramardana. The numberless progeny of Krura was much wicked as she herself was.

sa: सा तमृषिमनुप्राप्तं प्रत्युद्गम्याभिवाद्य च। संविवेशाभ्यनुज्ञाता सत्कृत्योपचचार ह॥
en: She rose up and saluted him as the Rishi came. After having waited upon him respectfully, she took her seat near him when asked,

sa: पापाचोर राक्षसी बुद्धिमाश्रितोऽनेकैरूपायैरुद्धर्तुं च भावित्याचार्थस्य शकितास्ते समुद्धर्तुम्॥
en: The sinful (Duryodhana), acting like a Rakshasa, attempted by various means to drive them away, but what is to be can never be prevented.

sa: यत्र सौगन्धिकार्थेऽसौ नलिनी तामधर्षयत्। यत्रास्य युद्धमभवत्सुमहद्राक्षसैः सह॥
en: His bath in the tank and the destruction of its flowers in searching for the sweet-scented the flower Nalini; his fight with powerful Rakshasas,

sa: जातः परमतेजस्वी विनतानन्दवर्धनः। तेजोराशिमिमं दृष्ट्वा युष्मान्मोहः समाविशत्॥
en: He is born endued with great energy to promote the joy of Vinata. Seeing this heap of effulgence, this delusion has come (in you).

sa: स बाल एव तत्रस्थश्चरन्नमितबुद्धिमान्। गृहे पन्नगराजस्य प्रयत्नात्परिरक्षितः॥
en: Though he was only a boy, yet he was grave and intelligent. He was kept with great care in the palace of the snake-king.

sa: क्रियागुणानां सर्वेषामिदमाख्यानमाश्रयः। इन्द्रियाणां समस्तानां चित्रा इव मनःक्रियाः॥
en: As all the senses are dependent on the wonderful workings of the mind, so all the acts and moral qualities depend on this treatise.

sa: स सिद्धचक्षुषा दृष्ट्वा तदन्नं द्विजसत्तमः। अभोज्यमिदमित्याह क्रोधपर्याकुलेक्षणः॥
en: That excellent Brahmana, seeing by his ascetic eye that the food was unworthy of being eaten, thus spoke with his eyes red in anger.

sa: एवमुक्तः सव्यसाची मण्डलीकृतकार्मुकः। तस्थौ भासं समुद्दिश्य गुरुवाक्यप्रचोदितः॥
en: Having been thus addressed Savyasachi (Arjuna), drawing the bow to a semi-circle, aimed at the bird and stood there as ordered by the preceptor.

sa: ततो गच्छद्धृषीकेशं द्वारवत्यां कदाचन। लब्धवांस्तत्र बीभत्सुर्भार्यां राजीवलोचनाम्॥
en: Thus roving about in many places, on one occasion, he went to Krishna in Dwarka and he obtained there for his wife the lotus-eyed,

sa: महत्त्वाद्धारवत्त्वाच्च महाभारतमुच्यते। निरुक्तमस्य यो वेद सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: It is called Mahabharata from this superiority in substance and gravity of import. He who understands its real meaning, is freed from all sins.

sa: अमात्यानुपधातीतान् पितृपैतामहाञ्छुचीन्। श्रेष्ठाञ्छ्रेष्ठेषु कच्चित् त्वं नियोजयसि कर्मसु॥
en: Have you appointed in high posts ministers who are guileless and well conducted from generations to generations, and who are above the common people?

sa: ततो लब्धवरा प्रीता स्त्रीभावगुणभूषिता। जगाम सह संसर्गमृषिणाद्भुतकर्मणा॥
en: Having obtained the boon, she became exceedingly pleased. She was in her season and she accepted the embraces of that Rishi of wonderful deeds.

sa: त्रिभिरासादितोऽस्माभिर्विजने स नराधिपः। न संदेहो यथा युद्धमेकेनाप्युपयास्यति॥
en: If we three go secretly to that king, there is no doubt he will be engaged in a single combat with one of us.

sa: तदेतदद्भुतं ब्रह्मञ्छाईकाणामनामयम्। कीर्तयस्वाग्निसम्मः कथं ते न विनाशिताः॥
en: O Brahmana, the escape of the Sharanagakas seems to be wonderful. Tell us why they were not destroyed by Agni in the great conflagration.

sa: लोहिताक्षो महाबाहुरूर्ध्वकेशो महाननः। मेघसंघातवर्मा च तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रो भयानकः॥
en: (He was) of red eyed and strong arms, of standing hair and large mouth, of colour like clouds, of sharp teeth and fearful appearance.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तां चर्यां पर्यपृच्छत। किमर्थं पाण्डवैतानि तीर्थान्यनुचरस्युत॥
en: Then Vasudeva (Krishna) asked Arjuna about his travels, saying, "O son of Pandu, why are you roaming over the earth seeing all the Tirthas?"

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु सहितैस्त्रिदशैर्मघवांस्तदा। तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रचक्राम सोऽपश्यत वने स्त्रियः॥
en: Having been thus addressed, Indra said “Be it so." He then, accompanied by the celestials set out. He saw many damsels in the forest.

sa: कच्चिदर्थेषु सम्प्रौढान् हितकामाननुप्रियान्। नापकर्षसि कर्मभ्यः पूर्वमप्राप्य किल्बिषम्॥
en: You surely do not dismiss without fault servants who are able in work, who are popular and who are always devoted to your welfare.

sa: अवमानाच्च लोभाच्च बाहुवीर्याच्च दर्पितः। भीमसेनेन युद्धाय ध्रुवमप्युपयास्यति॥
en: From the fear of disgrace, from covetousness, and from the pride of strength of arms, he will certainly challenge Bhima to a single combat.

sa: दिवाकरसमं दीप्त्या चारुसर्वाङ्गभूषितम्। निगूहमाना जातं वै बन्धुपक्षभयात्तदा॥
en: And as effulgent as the sun and every part of his body was well embellished. From the fear of her friends and relatives, privately,

sa: कामक्रोधोद्भवान्दोषान्निरस्य च नराधिपाः। धर्मेण दण्डं दण्ड्येषु प्रणयन्तोऽन्वपालयन्॥
en: All the kings (of the world), becoming free from vices born of lust and anger and punishing those that deserved punishment, protected the earth.

sa: श्येनपादपरिभ्रष्टं तद्वीर्यमथ वासवम्। जग्राह तरसोपेत्य साद्रिका मत्स्यरूपिणी॥
en: The fish, Adrika, rapidly came to the spot where Vasu's seed fell from the claws of the hawk and she swallowed it at once.

sa: स मारुत इवाभ्राणि नाशयित्वार्जुनः सुरान्॥ व्यधमच्छरसङ्घातैर्देहिनः खाण्डवालयान्।
en: Having scattered the celestial as the wind scatters the cloud, Arjuna killed with the showers of arrows numberless creatures who dwelt in the Khandava.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा जरत्कारुर्भृशं शोकपरायणः। उवाच तान्पितॄन्दुःखाद्बाष्पसंदिग्धया गिरा॥
en: Sauti said: Having heard all this, Jaratkaru became exceedingly sorry. He spoke to the pitres in sorrow and his words were choked by tears.

sa: अनाथास्तेन नाथेन यया दुष्कृतिनस्तथा। कस्त्वं बन्धुरिवास्माकमनुशोचसि सत्तम॥
en: Having means, we are like sinners who have no means. O excellent man, who are you that are sorrowing for us like a friend?

sa: तथा मन्त्रविदो विप्रास्तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुष्करम्। गुरूनभ्युपगच्छन्ति यशसोऽर्थाय भाविनि॥
en: O handsome lady, Brahmanas, learned in Mantras, after having acquired ascetic merits most difficult to be achieved, still go to their preceptors for fame.

sa: ततो भीमस्तमादाय गतासुं पुरुषादकम्। द्वारदेशे विनिक्षिप्य जगामानुपलक्षितः॥
en: Then Bhima took the dead cannibal and placed him at one of the gates (of the city) unobserved by anyone, he then went away.

sa: वसूनां पुनरुत्पत्तिर्भागीरथ्यां महात्मनाम्। शान्तनोर्वेश्मनि पुनस्तेषां चारोहणं दिवि॥
en: It describes the births of the graet Vasus in the house of Shantanu in the womb of Bhagirathi and their again going to heaven.

sa: जितारयो महाप्रज्ञाः सत्यधर्मपरायणाः। मुदं परमिकां प्राप्तास्तत्रोषुः पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥
en: Having defeated all their foes, the greatly wise and ever devoted to truth and virtue, the sons of Pandu lived there in great happiness.

sa: एष श्रियः समुदिताः सर्वराज्ञां ग्रहीष्यति। वर्षास्विवोदीर्णजला नदीनदनदीपतिः॥
en: He will seize the growing prosperity of all the kings, as the ocean receives the rivers swollen with the waters of the rainy season.

sa: कच्चिद् रक्ताम्बरधराः खगहस्ता: स्वलंकृताः। उपासते त्वामभितो रक्षणार्थमरिन्दम॥
en: O chastiser of foes, do men attired in purple clothes, armed with swords and adorned with ornaments, stand by you to protect your person?

sa: ततः सङ्गाद्गता धेनुः सवत्सा स्पर्शितानघ। ब्राह्मणस्याहिताग्नेस्तु दरिद्रस्योञ्छवर्तिनः॥
en: Accidentally on that occasion, a cow with calf belonging to a poor Brāhmaṇa, living upon law means, was given away along with other kine.

sa: दिष्ट्या भीमेन बलवाञ्जरासंधो निपातितः। राजानो मोक्षिताश्चैव बन्धनान्नृपसत्तम॥
en: "O best of kings, the powerful Jarasandha has been killed by Bhima from good fortune. The kings, confined at Girivraja, have all been liberated.

sa: अथर्ववेदप्रवराः पूगयज्ञियसामगाः। संहितामीरयन्ति स्म पदक्रमयुतां तु ते॥ शब्दसंस्कारसंयुक्तैर्बुवद्भिश्चापरैर्द्विजैः। नादितः स बभौ श्रीमान् ब्रह्मलोक इवापरः॥
en: Brahmanas, learned in the Atharva Veda, reciting the Sanhitas according to the proper rules of voice. At other places, Brahmanas learned in the science of ortheopy, were reciting Mantras of other kinds. That holy hermitage, resounding with these holy sounds, did really look like the region of Brahma.

sa: तच वाक्यमुपश्रुत्य भगवतामन्तरिक्षात् पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात; देवदुन्दुभयश्च प्रणेदुः॥
en: After the conclusion of the speech of these ascetics, flowers were showered down upon the place and celestial drums were beaten in the sky.

sa: हाहाभूता भयार्ता च निवृत्तविपणापणा। निवृत्तदेवकार्या च पुण्योद्वाहविवर्जिता॥
en: The people cried, “Alas! Alas!” and all buying and selling were stopped. The works of the celestials ceased and sacred ceremonies and marriages discontinued.

sa: अथ मायां पुनर्देवास्तयोश्चक्रुर्महात्मनोः। भगिन्यो मातरो भार्यास्तयोश्चात्मजनस्तथा।॥ प्रपात्यमाना विस्रस्ताः शूलहस्तेन रक्षसा। भ्रष्टाभरणकेशान्ता भ्रष्टाभरणवाससः॥ अभिभाष्य ततः सर्वास्तौ त्राहीति विचुक्रुशुः। न च तौ चक्रतुर्भङ्गं व्रतस्य सुमहाव्रतौ॥
en: Then the celestials celestials displayed Maya (delusion) before those (two) illustrious Rishis. It appeared to them as if their sisters, mothers, wives and other relatives, with dishevelled hair, ornaments and robes, were running towards them in terror, pursued and struck down by a Rakshasas who had a lance in his hands. It appeared as if they were all crying, "O save us! O save us.” But even this could not break the vows of those two great vowobserving Rishis.

sa: रमणीयं शिवं पुण्यं सर्वैर्जनमनोहरैः। नानापक्षिरुतं रम्यं कदूपुत्रप्रहर्षणम्॥
en: It was beautiful, beneficial, holy and charming to all. Echoing with the sweet notes of various birds, it much delighted the sons of Kadru.

sa: ततः स व्रतिभिः शिष्यैस्तपोयुक्तैर्महातपाः। वृतः प्रायान्महाबाहुर्महेन्द्रं पर्वतोत्तमम्॥
en: Thereupon, the mighty-armed and greatly ascetic (Drona), accompanied by his disciples who were all devoted to vows and asceticism, started for the Mahendra mountain.

sa: यक्षराक्षसगन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगदानवाः। विस्तरं कुरुवंशस्य धीमन्तः कथयन्ति ते॥
en: The Yakshas, the Rakshasas, the Gandharvas, the Pishachas, the Uragas and the Danavas are wise and intelligent. They speak much of the Kury race.

sa: अथ सर्पानुवाचेदं सर्वान्परमहष्टवत्। इदमानीतममृतं निक्षेप्स्यामि कुशेषु वः॥
en: He then said to all the snakes in joy, "Here have I brought the Ambrosia. I shall place it on the (sacred) Kusha grass.

sa: ततोऽस्त्रं वारुणं सम्यग् योजयामास कौरवः। तेनाश्वांश्चतुरोऽमृद्गच्छाल्वराजस्य भूपते॥
en: O king, the Kuru prince then attached the Varuna weapon to his bow-string and he wounded with it the four steeds of king Shalva.

sa: तथा शपन्त्यां वैदेह्या प्रादुरासीत्तदद्भुतम्। भूतलादुत्थितं दिव्यं सिंहासनमनुत्तमम्॥
en: As soon as Sītā swore in this wise a wonderful incident took place. From inside the earth a celestial and excellent throne rose up.

sa: ततः सिंहपुरं रम्यं चित्रायुधसुरक्षितम्। प्राधमद् बलमास्थाय पाकशासनिराहवे॥
en: The son of the chastiser of Paka (Arjuna) then conquered the charming city of Singhapura which was well protected by all kinds of weapons.

sa: किमर्जुनश्चाप्यकरोत् संशप्तकबलं प्रति। संशप्तका पार्थस्य किमकुर्वत संजय॥
en: What also did Arjuna do to the car-warriors of the Samshaptaka host and what, O Sanjaya, did the Samshaptakas do to Arjuna in return?

sa: चेकितानं तथाभूतं दृष्ट्वा समरदुर्मदः। रथमारोपयच्चैनं सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः॥
en: And that hero invincible in battle seeing Chekitana in that plight, placed him on his car before the very eyes of all the troops.

sa: राजा तु मध्यमानीके कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। बृहद्भिः कुञ्चरैर्मत्तैश्चलद्भिरचलैरिव॥
en: Then king Yudhishthira, surrounded by huge and various elephants each resembling a moving hill, took up his position in the centre of the army.

sa: अभिगम्यार्जुनं वीरं राजभिर्बहुभिर्वृतः। पुरस्तात् पृष्ठतश्चैव पार्श्वतश्चैव सर्वतः॥
en: Surrounded by innumerable monarchs, he attacked the heroic Arjuna from all sides, namely in the front, in the rear and in the two flanks.

sa: नानावादिनिनदैः क्ष्वेडितोत्कृष्टगर्जितैः। हुंकारैः सिंहनादैश्च तिष्ठ तिष्ठति नि:स्वनैः॥
en: With the sound of various musical instruments, with shouts and slappings of armpits and war-cries, with yells, leonine roars, with cries of 'Slay, slay.'

sa: रथव्रजेन संरुद्धस्तैरमित्रैस्तथाऽऽर्जुनिः। वृषसेनस्य यन्तारं हत्वा चिच्छेद कार्मुकम्॥
en: Then impaled by the enemies with crowds of cars, the son of Arjuna slew the driver of Vrishasena and also cut-off the latter's bow.

sa: समेत्य तु महासेने चक्रतुर्वेगमुत्तमम्। जाह्नवीयमुने नद्यौ प्रावृषीवोल्बणोदके॥
en: Clashing against each other, the two armies put forth their exertions, like the rivers Ganga and Yamuna swelling with water during the rain season.

sa: नाकुलिं तु शतानीकं शालपुष्पनिभा हयाः। आदित्यतरुणप्रख्याः श्लाघनीयमुदावहन्॥
en: Steeds, resembling the flower of the Sala in hue and radiant like the rising sun, bore the glorious son of Nakula, by name Shatanika.

sa: तमर्जुनः शतेनाजौ राजन् विव्याध पत्रिणाम्। पुनश्चान्यैस्त्रिभिर्बाणैर्मोहयन्निव सात्वतम्॥
en: O king, Arjuna pierced him in battle with sharp shafts again with another three arrows he confounded the descendant of the Satvata race (Kritavarman).

sa: न्यकृन्तन्नुत्तमाङ्गानि विचरन्तो दिशो दश। अभ्याहता हयारोहा ऋष्ठियभर्भरतर्षभ॥
en: Cut down the head of those horsemen, coursing all over the field. Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, the horse-riders thus struck with swords,

sa: बभ्रमुः समरे नागा मृद्नन्तः शतशो नरान्। कार्णायसतनुत्राणान् नराश्वरथकुञ्जरान्॥ पतितान् पोथयाञ्चकुर्द्विपाः स्थूलनलानिव। गृघ्रपत्राधिवासांसि शयनानि नराधिपाः॥
en: Elephants careered through the field crushing men by hundreds. Some elephants again pressed and squeezed many fallen men, steeds, car-warriors and elephants, all furnished with iron armours, as if they were merely thick stalk or recds. On beds of arrows furnished with vulterine feathers, many rulers of men.

sa: कवचैः शोणितादिग्धैविप्रकीर्णश्च काञ्चनैः। रराज सुभृशं भूमिः शान्तार्चिभिरिवानलैः॥
en: Covered over with blood-soiled amours and golden ornaments, the field of battle appeared most beautiful as of scattered over with fires of mild flames.

sa: स शस्त्रवृष्ट्याऽभिहतः समस्तैस्तैर्महारथैः। प्राग्ज्योतिषगजो राजन् नानालिङ्गैः सुतेजनैः॥
en: That elephants of the ruler of the Pragjyotishas, O king, being struck by all those mighty warriors, with sharers of weapons of diverse description.

sa: श्रुत्वा हतं रुक्मरथं वैयाघ्रपरिवारितम्। जातरूपशिरस्त्राणं नाद्य शोकमपानुदे॥
en: Hearing the death that hero of golden car covered with tiger-skins, whose effulgence was like that of gold, I cannot today discard my grief.

sa: प्रादुश्चक्रे तदाग्नेयमस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः। तस्य दीप्तशरौघस्य दीप्तचापधरस्य च॥
en: Dhananjaya however with the network of arrows woven by himself, repulsed the arrowy downpour of that hero (Karna) of bright shafts and effulgent bow.

sa: कन्याश्चन्दनचूर्णैश्च लाजैर्माल्यैश्च सर्वशः। अवाकिरज्छान्तनवं तत्र गत्वा सहस्रशः॥
en: Repairing there by thousands, maidens covered the son of Shantanu on all parts of his body, with pulverised sandal-wood. fieldpaddy, and garlands of flowers.

sa: आसीच्छक्त्यासिसम्पातो युद्धमासीत् परश्वधैः। प्रकृष्टमसियुद्धं च बभूव कटुकोदयम्॥
en: There were then veritable showers of lances and swords; and the battle was fought with battle-axes. Dreadful sword-fights producing great carnage were also fought.

sa: इत्युक्तो वासुदेवेन बीभत्सुरपराजितः। आबभाषे तदा विद्वानिदं वचनमर्थवत्॥
en: Having been thus spoken to by the son of Vasudeva, the invincible and learned Vibhatsu said these words of (grave) signification to the former

sa: अजेयस्त्वं रणेऽरीणामपि वज्रभृतः स्वयम्। इत्येवमुक्त्वा वरदा क्षणेनान्तरधीयत॥
en: You are incapable of being defeated by any foe, not even by the wielder of thunder-bolt (Indra). Having said this, that boon-giving goddess disappeared.

sa: स पपात महाबाहुर्वसुधामनुनादयन्॥ इन्द्रध्वज इवोत्सृष्टः केतुः सर्वधनुष्मताम्।
en: That foremost of all bowmen, that mightyarmed hero fell like an uprooted standard in honour of Indra, causing the earth tremble for the while.

sa: शरैरेकायनीकुर्वन् दिशः सर्वा यतव्रतः। जघान पाण्डवरथानादिश्य भरतर्षभ॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, showering continuous arrows in all directions, that hero of rigid vows (Bhishma) struck the Pandava warriors calling each by name.

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम पार्षतस्य पराक्रमम्। न्यवारयत यस्तूर्णं शल्यं समितिशोभनम्॥
en: Then we saw the highly wonderful prowess of the son of Prishata, as he speedily checked (the career of) Shalya the ornament of assemblies.

sa: तस्मादज्ञानसम्भूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनाऽऽत्मनः। छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत॥
en: Therefore, Oh descendant of Bharata, destroying with the sword of knowledge these inisgivings of yours produced from ignorance, engage in yoga of action, Arise.

sa: एवं दुःशासनबलं वध्यमानं किरीटिना। सम्प्राद्रवन्महाराज व्यथितं सहनायकम्॥
en: Thus, O mighty monarch, the army of Dushasana with its leader, deeply afflicted and extensively slaughtered by the diadem-decked Arjuna, began to fly away.

sa: परिवेषस्तथा घोरश्चन्द्रभास्करयोरभूत्। वेदयानो भयं घोरं राज्ञां देहावकर्तनम्॥
en: The and the lunar discs have assumed dreadful aspects, foreboding terrible calamity to the kings, in the shape of the mangling of। their bodies.

sa: स विस्फार्य महच्चापमिन्द्राशनिसमप्रभम्। तर्जयामास वेगेन पाण्डवानां महारथान्॥
en: Then stretching his mighty bow equal to the thunder bolt of Indra in effulgence, he assailed with vehemence the mighty car-warriors of the Pandavas,

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य संक्रुद्धं भीमदर्शनम्। समभ्यधावंस्त्वरिताः कौरवाणां महारथाः॥
en: Beholding the engaged Bhima of terrible expression thus fall upon them, the mighty carwarriors of the Kaurava host proceeded to meet him without delay.

sa: अर्धमानाः शरैरेते रुक्मपुजैर्महात्मना। पथा नैकेन गच्छन्ति धूर्णमानास्ततस्ततः॥
en: Afflicted by the gold-winged shafts of the ilustrious Drona, they are flying away by diverse paths; and they seem to whirl round and round.

sa: अनतिक्रमणीयो वै विधिरेष युधिष्ठिर। देवदानवगन्धर्वान् मृत्युर्हरति भारत॥
en: O Yudhishthira, this law (that created being shall die) cannot be violated. O Bharata, Death takes away all Gods, Danavas and Gandharvas, (without exception).

sa: तत्रैनमर्जुनश्चैव पार्षतश्च सहानुगः। प्रत्यगृह्णात् ततः सर्वे समापेतुर्महारथाः॥
en: to Thereupon the mighty car-warriors namely Arjuna and the son of Prishata together with their followers, encompassed Drona, as he was rushing at them.

sa: सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि। ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः॥
en: I am never lost to him and he is never lost to Me, who sees Me in everything, and sees every thing in Me.

sa: चेदिकाशिकरूषेषु पञ्चालेषु च भारत। भीष्मस्य बहुधा तालश्चलत्केतुरदृश्यत्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the palmyra standard of Bhishma was seen to glide continuously through the Chedis, the Kashis, the Karushas and the Panchalas.

sa: इति नित्यं योगविद्भिर्भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमः। सनत्कुमारप्रमुखैः स्तूयतेऽभ्यर्च्यते हरिः॥
en: Even thus is that almighty and excellent Being Hari always adored and eulogised by sages conversant with the Yoga who are headed by Sanatkumara".

sa: सम्मोहयित्वा तमथ दुर्योधनममोचयन्। आस्याद् ग्रासमिवाक्षिप्तं ममृषे नार्जुनात्मजः॥
en: Then thus confounding the latter, they rescued Duryodhana. But Arjuna's son did not tolerate this snatching away of the monarch from his very mouth.

sa: पर्वतो वारिधाराभिवर्षमाणैरिवाम्बुदैः॥ स तु क्रोधसमाविष्टः पाण्डवानां महारथः।
en: Like a mountain washed with thick shower of rain poured down by the clouds. Then possessed with anger that mighty car-warrior of the Pandavas,

sa: चापमण्डलमेवास्य विस्फुरद् दिक्ष्वदृश्यत। सुदीप्तस्य शरत्काले सवितुर्मण्डलं यथा॥
en: Only his bow drawn to the fullest stretch could then be seen blazing like the burning disc of the sun in the autumnal sky.

sa: तथैव पौरवं युद्धे धृष्टकेतुर्महारथः। त्रिंशता निशितैर्बाणैर्विव्याधाशु महाभुजः॥
en: Similarly the mighty car-warrior Dhrishtketu endued with great might, pierced in that battle that descendant of Kuru with three hundred shafts of great sharpness.

sa: के रक्षन् पाण्डवानीके शिखण्डिनमुदाययुधाः। त्वरमाणास्त्वराकाले जिगीषन्तो महारथाः॥
en: Who were those mighty car-warriors that activity defended Shikhandin in that occasion needing great activity, with their weapons upraised and heart longing for victory?

sa: मण्डलीकृतमेवास्य धनुः पश्याम भारत। सूर्यमण्डलसंकाशं दहतस्तव वाहिनीम्॥
en: When, O Bharata, he thus consumed your ranks, I saw his bow drawn as to resembled a circle and the solar disc of effulgence.

sa: बन्धुरात्माऽऽत्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवाऽऽत्मना जितः। अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्॥
en: To him, who has subjugated his self, his self has become a friend but to him who has not subjugated his self, his self.

sa: स लोकविदितानश्वान् निजघान महाबलः। द्रौणे: पाञ्चालदायादः शितैर्दशभिराशुगैः॥
en: The mighty heir-apparent of the king of Panchala with many sharp arrows killed the horses of Drona's who is celebrated all over the world.

sa: वीरबाहुविसृष्टानां तोमराणां विशाम्पते। रूपमासीद् वियत्स्थानां सर्पाणामिव सर्पताम्॥
en: The appearance of lances hurled by the arms of heroes was, O ruler of men, like that of serpents coursing swiftly through the welkin.

sa: दर्शनीयास्तु काम्बोजाः शुकपत्रपरिच्छदाः। वहन्तो नकुलं शीघ्रं तावकानभिदुद्रुवुः॥
en: Steeds of Kamboja bred beautiful to look at the decked with the feathers of the Shuka bird, bearing Nakula, quickly made against your army.

sa: अथ कार्णायसैर्वाणैः पूर्णकार्मुकनिःसृतैः। अविध्यद् देवकीपुत्रं हेमपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Thereafter Bhagadatta, with iron shafts furnished with golden wings, whetted on stone and discharged from a full-drawn bow, pierced the illustrious son of Devaki.

sa: अवारयदमेयात्मा वारिवेगानिवाचलः। स निरुद्धेषु सर्वेषु पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु॥
en: That high-souled hero (Bhishma) stopped them all as a mountain resists the wind. When the illustrious warriors of the Pandava army were thus checked.

sa: आजघान सुसंक्रुद्धः कालान्तकयमोपमः। तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य संक्रुद्धं भीमदर्शनम्॥
en: Advanced, greatly excited with rage, like the Destroyer at the time of universal annihilation. Beholding that irate hero of dreadful appearance make towards himself.

sa: द्रोणमावारितं दृष्ट्वा भृशायस्तस्तवात्मजः। नानालिङ्गैः शरवातैः पार्षतं सममोहयत्॥
en: Seeing Drona covered, your son quickly came to his help and confounded the son of Prishata, with a downpour of arrows of various appearance.

sa: संजय उवाच समारोप्य महच्चापमभिवाद्य पितामहम्। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then Arjuna, fixing the string on his mighty bow and saluting the grandsire and with his eyes overflowing with tears thus spoke.

sa: पादपैः पुष्पविकचैः फलभारावनामिभिः। शोभिते सर्वतो रम्यैः पुंस्कोकिलगणायुतैः॥
en: They were beautiful on all sides with trees bearing brown blossoms, bending down with the weight of their fruits, frequented by numerous male Kokilas,

sa: ततः समुद्रं पश्यामि यादोगणनिषेवितम्। रत्नाकरममित्रघ्न पयसो निधिमुत्तमम्॥
en: O chastiser of foes, I saw there also the ocean inhabited by alligators and sharks, that mine of gems, that excellent abode of waters.

sa: तत्र पश्यामि गगनं चन्द्रसूर्यविराजितम्। जाज्वल्यमानं तेजोभिः पावकार्कसमप्रभम्॥
en: I saw there also the sky adorned with the sun and the moon, blazing in great effulgence and possessing the lustre of the sun.

sa: पुलस्त्य उवाच ततो गच्छेन्महाराजधर्मतीर्थमनुत्तमम्। यत्रधर्मो महाभागस्तप्तवानुत्तमं तपः॥
en: Pulastya said : O great king, one should then go to the excellent Tirtha, called Dharma where the greatly exalted Dharma performed excellent asceticism.

sa: तृतीयमपि मासं स पक्षणाहारमाचरन्। चतुर्थे त्वथ सम्प्राप्ते मासे भरतसत्तमः॥ वायुभक्षो महाबाहुरभवत् पाण्डुनन्दनः। ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्निरालम्बः पादाङ्गुष्ठाचविष्ठितः॥
en: In the third (month) at the interval of a fortnight. When the fourth month came, that foremost of the Bharata race. That mightyarmed son of Pandu lived (simply) on air, with his arms upraised and with nothing to lean upon, standing only on the tips of his toes.

sa: तिर्यग्योनिसहस्राणि गत्वा नरकमेव च। जीवाः सम्परिवर्तन्ते कर्मबन्धनिबन्धनाः॥
en: Passing through hell and also through thousands of various births, our souls bound by the bonds of their own Karma travel (for everlasting time).

sa: देवदानवगन्धर्वमनुष्योरगराक्षसाः। प्राप्नुवन्ति विपर्यासं किं नु दुःखतरं ततः॥
en: What can be a greater sorrow than to witness) the reverses of the celestials, the Danavas, the Gandharvas, men, the Nagas and the Rakshasas?

sa: अगच्छत् पर्वतं पुण्यमेकाद्वैव महामनाः। मनोजवगतिर्भूत्वा योगयुक्तो यथानिलः॥
en: The high-minded hero reached the sacred mountain in one day, for he, being a great ascetic, possessed the speed like that of the mind.

sa: आकृष्यमाणे वसने द्रौपद्यास्तु विशाम्पते। तद्रूपमपरं वस्त्रं प्रादुरासीदनेकशः॥
en: O king, as the cloth of Draupadi was being dragged, after one was taken off, another of the same kind appeared and covered her.

sa: अत्र कृत्यं प्रपश्यामि प्राप्तकालमरिदम। कृष्णद्वैपायनात् तात गृहीतोपनिषन्मया।॥
en: O chastiser of foes, I shall tell you what you should do now. O child, I have received a knowledge from Krishna Dvaipayana (Vyasa).

sa: त्वं पुनर्धातृसहितः कृष्णाया चैव पाण्डव। रमसेऽस्मिन् महारण्येधर्ममेवानुचिन्तयन्॥
en: O son of Pandu, you, however, with Krishna (Draupadi) and your brothers, sport here in this great forest, with your heart fixed on virtue.

sa: हतैर्निवातकवचैर्निरस्तैः पर्वतोपमैः। समाच्छाद्यत देशः स विकीर्णैरिव पर्वतैः॥
en: That place was completely filled with those Nivatakavachas looking like mountains, who were (either) killed or wounded and lying scattered like (so many) rocks.

sa: इतश्चतुर्दशे वर्षे विनक्ष्यन्तीह कौरवाः। दुर्योधनापराधेन भीमार्जुनबलेन च॥
en: Narada said On the fourteenth year hence, for the fault of Duryodhana will be destroyed the Kurus by the prowess of Bhima and Arjuna.

sa: यथा सुराणां सर्वेषामादिस्तु मधुसूदनः॥ तथैव पुष्करं राजंस्तीर्थानामादिरुच्यते।
en: O king, as the slayer of Madhu is the origin of all the celestials, so is, Pushkara called the origin of all the Tirthas.

sa: निर्मलानि शरीराणि विशुद्धानि शरीरिणाम्। ससर्जधर्मतन्त्राणि पूर्वोत्पन्नः प्रजापतिः॥
en: Prajapati (the lord of all created beings) who first sprang into existence, created for the corporeal beings, bodies, stainless, pure and given to virtue.

sa: इह देवैः सहेन्द्रश्च प्रजापतिभिरेव च। इष्टं बहुविधैर्यज्ञैर्महद्भिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः॥
en: Here did the celestials with Indra and Prajapati (Brahma) perform many sacrifices on a large scale and paid large Dakshinas to the ministering priests.

sa: तेषां प्रादुष्कृताग्नीनां मुहूर्ते रम्यदारुणे। ब्रह्मघोषपुरस्कारः संजल्प: समजायत॥
en: That terrible evening hours became in a moinent delightful on account of those Brahmana's lighting their fire, chanting the Vedas and holding mutual conversations.

sa: अतश्चोद्यन्तमादित्यमुपतिष्ठन्ति वै प्रजाः। ऋषयश्चापिधर्मज्ञाः सिद्धाः साध्याश्च देवताः॥
en: The twice-born ones and the righteous sages and the Siddhas and the Sadhyas and the celestials, worship the sun who rises from this point.

sa: कथं वत्स्यथ दुर्गेषु वने ऋद्धिविनाकृताः। वीर्यसत्त्वबलोत्साहतेजोभिरकृशाः कृशाः॥
en: Your are not wanting in energy prowess, strength, firmness and might. How will you live in great wilderness shorn of your wealth and possession?

sa: एकासनोपविष्टौ तौ शोभयांचक्रतुः सभाम्। सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ व्योम चतुर्दश्यामिवोदितौ॥
en: Seated on one seat, they beautified the assembly like the sun and moon beautifying the sky on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight.

sa: अथ वा कृपणैरेतामुपनीतां जनार्दना। पूजामनर्हः कस्मात् त्वमभ्यनुज्ञातवानसि॥
en: O Janardana, why did you accept the worship of which you are not worthy, although it was offered to you by these mean-minded princes?

sa: ख्यातमद्यापि कौन्तेय तद् विद्धि भरतर्षभ। अथाब्रवीदनिमिषस्तानृषीन् सहितस्तदा॥
en: And is celebrated as such up to date. O son of Kunti, know this. Then that fish thus spoke to those Rishis assembled together,

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। ईश्वरस्य वशे लोकास्तिष्ठन्ते नात्यनो यथा॥
en: I shall cite here an old historical incident as an illustration that men are subject to the will of Providence and not to themselves.

sa: भ्राता च मे यः स सखा गुरुश्च जनार्दनस्यात्मसमश्च पार्थः। यदर्थमैच्छन् मनुजाः सुपुत्रं शिष्यं गुस्श्चाप्रतिकूलवादम्॥
en: The son of Pritha (Arjuna) is my brother, he is my friend, he is also my preceptor; and he is like the second self of Krishna. It is for this reason that men desire for a worthy son and that a preceptor seeks an obedient and obliging pupil.

sa: अतिरस्कृतसम्भाषा दुःस्त्रियो नानुसेवती। अनुकूलवती नित्यं भवाम्यनलसा सदा॥
en: I am never angry, I never speak harsh words, I never imitate women that are wicked. Avoiding idleness, I always do what is agreeable.

sa: श्रुत्वारण्ये विलपितं न मामाश्वासयत्ययम्। यात्येतां स्वादुसलिलामापगां सागरंगमाम्॥
en: Hearing me bewailing in this wilderness, this forest king himself, is wending towards the rivulet containing tasteful water that is rolling towards the sea.

sa: यदृच्छयाधनुष्पाणिर्बद्धखङ्गो वृकोदरः। ददर्श तद् वनं रम्यं देवगन्धर्वसेवितम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Vrikodara wandering at pleasure armed with (his) bow and sword, beheld that delightful forest frequented by the celestials and the Gandharvas.

sa: महाकालं ततो गच्छेन्नियतो नियताशनः। कोटितीर्थमुपस्पृश्य हयमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: One should then go to Mahakala with regulated diet and vows. Having bathed in the Kati Tirtha he obtains the fruit of a horsesacrifice.

sa: तं चिन्तयानमासीनं धृतराष्ट्रं जनेश्वरम्। निःश्वसन्तमनेकाग्रमिति होवाच संजयः॥
en: When the ruler of men, Dhritarashtra was thus seated in anxiety and restlessness and sighing in grief, Sanjaya came to him and spoke thus.

sa: तत्रापि च कृतोद्देशः समागमदिदृक्षुभिः। कृतश्च समयस्तेन पार्थेनामिततेजसा॥
en: And we too, with an ardent desire to meet him, had engaged to repair thither. It had been appointed by Partha of matchless prowess,

sa: नाप्राप्य पाण्डवैश्वर्यं संशयो मे भविष्यति। अवाप्स्ये वा श्रियं तां हि शयिष्ये वा हतो युधि॥
en: Covet as much as I do the wealth and prosperity of the Pandavas, they have not as yet become my own. I am doubtful about my ability; I am, however, determined to remove my doubt. I will either obtain their wealth or lay my own life in battle.

sa: हिंसाभिरामश्च जनस्तथा सम्पद्यतेऽशुचिः। अधर्मफलमत्यर्थं तदा भवति चानघा॥
en: Unholy both in thought and deed, men take pleasure in envy and malice. O sinless one, the earth becomes full of sin and immorality.

sa: वातं तमेवाभिमुखो यतस्तत् पुष्पमागतम्। आजिहीर्षुर्जगामाशु स पुष्पाण्यपराण्यपि॥
en: Eager to fetch the flowers, he proceeded at a very rapid pace facing the wind, in the direction from which the lotus had come.

sa: प्रयतिष्ये महाराज तमानेतुं तपोधनम्। अभिप्रेतांस्तु मे कामांस्त्वमनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥ ततः शक्ष्याम्यानयितुमृष्यशृङ्गमृषेः सुतम्। तस्याः सर्वमभिप्रेतमन्वजानात् स पार्थिवः॥
en: "O great king, I shall try to bring here that great ascetic. You should however order to procure for me certain things in connection with it. I shall then be able to bring the Rishi's son Rishyashringa here." The king ordered that everything she wanted should be procured.

sa: स पपात महाबाहुर्वजाहत इवाचलः। ततश्चेदिपतेर्दैहात् तेजोऽयं ददृशुर्नृपाः॥
en: The mighty armed hero fell like a cliff struck by thunder. The kings saw a fearful effulgence from the body of the Chedi king.

sa: समुल्लिखद्भिरेतैर्हि त्वया शृङ्गशतैर्नृपः। कच्चिद् दृष्टोऽचलश्रेष्ठ वनेऽस्मिन् दारुणेनलः॥
en: O foremost of mountains! by means of your hundred peaks reaching the skies, have you seen anywhere in this dreary wilderness the royal Nala?

sa: अणुरप्यपचारश्च नास्त्यस्माकं नराशन। विघसाशान् यथाशक्त्या कुर्महे देवतादिषु॥
en: O cannibal, we have never committed the least wrong. Living on Vegasha we serve the celestials and other to the best of our power.

sa: तेन शब्देन चैवाथ भीमसेनरवेण च। वनान्तरगताश्चापि वित्रेसुगपक्षिणः॥
en: With the roarings of these (animals), as well as with the shouts of Bhima, the wild animals living in distant forests were also alarmed.

sa: एवमेवाभिभाषन्तो विद्रवन्ति भयात् तदा। पुनरेवाभिधास्यामि चिन्तयध्वं सुकातराः॥
en: You terror-stricken ones! think upon the words that I tell you again. Exclaiming in the way as above, they all ran about in fright.

sa: ततोऽभिपीडितैर्गात्रैः पिण्डीकृत इवाबभौ। फाल्गुनो गात्रसंरुद्धो देवदेवेन भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, Falguni (Arjuna) thus pressed by the god of gods and his body bruised, became almost like a ball of flesh.

sa: तेन द्वादशवार्षिक्यामनावृष्ट्यां महात्मना। वृष्टं सस्यविवृद्ध्यर्थं मिषतो वज्रपाणिनः॥
en: When there was a draught extending for twelve years, disregarding the wielder of thunder, he caused rain to fall for the growth of crops.

sa: सुनीथः प्रीतिमांश्चैव ह्यनुकर्षं महाबलः। ध्वजं चेदिपतिश्चैवमहार्षीत् स्वयमुद्यतम्॥
en: The greatly strong Sunitha gladly fitted its lower pole and the ruler of Chedi with his own hands took up and fitted its flag-staff.

sa: एतस्मिन् कथ्यमाने तु लोकपालाश्च साग्निकाः। आजग्मुर्देवराजस्य समीपममरोत्तमाः॥
en: While they were discoursing thus, the most excellent of the immortals, the Lokapalas, (with Agni among them) came before the king of heaven, Indra.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वाश्रुपूर्णाक्षी पर्णादस्य विशाम्पते। दमयन्ती रहोऽभ्येत्य मातरं प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: O monarch, hearing these words of Parnada, Damayanti, with her eyes filled with tears, repaired to her mother and said to her these words,

sa: ततोऽपश्यं त्रिशिरसं पुरुषं नवलोचनम्। त्रिमुखं षड्भुजं दीप्तमर्कज्वलनमूर्धजम्॥
en: Then I beheld a person with three heads, nine eyes, three faces, six arms and with hair blazing as the sun or the fire.

sa: शीर्षयोः पतिता वृक्षा बिभिदु:कधा तयोः॥ यथैवौत्पलपत्राणि मत्तयोर्द्विपयोस्तथा।
en: The trees, struck at the heads (of the two combatants), were broken into minute pieces, like lotus-stalks thrown on the temples of mad elephants.

sa: ततस्तौ तत्र संरब्धौ राजमानौ मुहुर्मुहुः। शरैराशीविषाकारैस्ततक्षाते परस्परम्॥
en: Thereupon both of thein became angry. Engaging in a fearful fight, they hurled again and again at each other showers of poisonous snake-like arrows.

sa: काम पूर्वेधनं मध्ये जघन्येधर्ममाचरेत्। वयस्यनुचरेदेवमेष शास्त्रकृतो विधिः॥
en: The Shastras ordain that one should pursue pleasure in the first, profit in the second and virtue in the last portion of his life.

sa: तच्च क्रोधवशा नाम राक्षसा राजशासनात्। रक्षन्ति शतसाहस्रश्चित्रायुधपरिच्छदाः॥
en: At the command of their king hundreds and thousands of Rakshasas, called Krodhavasas, clad in uniforms and armed with various weapons, were guarding it.

sa: एतदीदृशकं तात रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। प्राप्तमासीन्महाराज विष्णुमासाद्य वै पुरा॥
en: O child, O great king, this was what happened in the days of yore to Rama of spotless deeds when he met with Vishnu.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजाः कुम्भकर्ण महाबलम्। पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मेने राक्षसपुङ्गवः॥
en: Having spoken thus to Kumbhakarna endowed with prodigious might, that foremost of Rakşasas-the exceedingly energetic Rāvaņa-felt as if he had received life over again.

sa: स संप्राप्य चिरात्संज्ञामृषभो वानरेश्वरः। क्रुद्धो विस्फुरमाणौष्ठौ महापार्श्वमुदैवत॥
en: And regaining his senses after a long while, Risabha-lord of monkeys-inflamed with wrath pouting out his upper lip, gazed at Mahāpārsva.* *Otherwise, called Matta.

sa: शतं शतसहस्राणां कोटिमाहुर्मनीषिणः। शतं कोटिसहस्राणां शङ्कुरित्यभिधीयते ॥
en: An hundred of an hundred thousand is called a koți by the wise. An hundred of a thousand kot i is called a Sanku.

sa: को भवानरूपसंपन्नो दिव्यस्त्रगनुलेपनः। वसानो विरजे वस्त्रे दिव्याभरणभूषितः॥
en: Who are your, furnished with beauty, and bearing wreaths and unguents (on your person); clad in stainless attire: and adorned in noble ornaments ?

sa: ते तपन्तमिवादित्यं घोरैर्बाणगभस्तिभिः। अभ्यधावन्त संक्रुद्धाः संयुगे वानरर्षभाः॥
en: Then waxing highly enraged, those considerable monkeys in that conflict hotly pursued (Indrajit) resembling the sun himself and having terrific arrows for his rays.

sa: एतानस्थिचयान्पश्य य एते शङ्खपाण्डुराः। युद्धार्थिनामिमे राजन्वानराधिपतेजसा ॥
en: Behold, O Dasanana, there lie the bones of all those, like conch, who came ere this to fight with the powerful king of monkeys.

sa: तद्भवान्यदि नो ह्यद्य दद्यादतुलविक्रम॥ कृता भवेन्मम प्रीतिर्धर्मश्चैवानुपालितः।
en: Therefore, O you of unrivalled prowess, if you should render the same (back), I shall be highly gratified; and righteousness also you will maintain.

sa: प्रदीप्तामिव तत्रस्थो मारुतिः समुदैक्षत। निष्पत्रशाखां विहगैः क्रियमाणामिवासकृत्॥
en: And stationed there Maruti beheld trees as if devoid of leaves on account of the hundreds of birds, adorned with various flowers, resorting there.

sa: वैनतेयस्ततः क्रुद्धः पक्षवातेन राक्षसम्। व्यपोहबलवान्वायुः शुष्कपर्णचयं यथा।॥
en: Thereat Vinata's son, growing engaged, drove the Rākşasas away with the wind of his wings, even as the lusty wind bloweth about sere leaves.

sa: तां भय॑मानां सम्प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसेन्द्रेण जानकीम्। देवगन्धर्वकन्यास्ता विषेदुर्विकृतेक्षणाः॥
en: Beholding the lord of Rākşasas remonstrate with the daughter of Janaka is this wise, the daughters of the celestials and Gandharvas became exceedingly sorry.

sa: मानुषाणामविषये चरतः कामरूपिणः। विनाशस्तव रामेण संयुगे नोपपद्यते॥
