en: You who are capable of assuming shapes at will have been slain in conflict by Rāma, in the city of Lankā unapproachable by men.

sa: क्षिप्रमद्यैव दुर्धर्षां पुरीं रावणपालिताम्। अभियाम जवेनैव सर्वैर्हरिभिरावृताः॥
en: Surrounded by all the monkeys, will we, using speed, this very day rapidly enter into the city ruled by Ravana, incapable of being subdued.

sa: विध्वस्तकवचौ वीरौ विप्रविद्धशरासनौ। सायकैश्छिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ शरस्तम्बमयौ क्षितौ ॥
en: Those heroes were lying on the earth, their mail torn, their bows cast off their bodies mangled all over and thickly pierce with shafts.

sa: स ताभ्यां विक्षतैर्गात्रैरसृग्दिग्धतनूरुहः। अभवद् वानरः क्रुद्धो बालसूर्यसमप्रभः॥
en: And with his limbs wounded by them, and his hair wetted with blood, that monkey resembling in splendour the infant sun, grew furiously enraged.

sa: स वायुमार्गमास्थाय वायुतुल्यगतिर्द्विजः। पुरी माहिष्मती प्राप्तो मनःसंपातविक्रमः॥
en: Proceeding by the aerial way, that twice-born one, gifted with the velocity of wind and the flight of wind, reached the city of Māhismati.

sa: विनेदुश्च महाघोषाः शङ्खाः शतसहस्रशः। राक्षसानां सुघोराणां मुखमारुतपूरिताः॥
en: And conchs by hundreds and by thousands, capable of producing loud blares, filled with air proceeding from the mouths of dreadful Rāks asas-were winded.

sa: लङ्घनार्थं च घोरस्य समुद्रस्य नदीपतेः। सहास्माभिरिहोपेतः सूक्ष्मबुद्धिर्विचारय॥
en: Drawing nigh to us, do you, gifted with acute intelligence, cast about for crossing over the dreadful deep, lord of streams, along with us.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा प्रीतिहृष्टाङ्गो रामस्तं परिषस्वजे। हनूमन्तं कृतात्मनं कृतवाक्यमुपागतम्॥
en: Having said this, Rama, with his down standing on end in joy, embraced the selfcontrolled Hanumān, who was present after having finished his speech.

sa: हरयो मथिता नागै रथजालैस्तथापरे। शयाना मृदितास्तत्र वायुवेगैरिवाम्बुदाः॥
en: The monkeys, hard pressed by elephants, and others by networks of cars, lie low in the field, having been agitated like clouds by winds.

sa: घूर्णन्त्यो मदशेषेण निद्रया च शुभाननाः। स्वेदक्लिष्टाङ्गकुसुमाः समाल्याकुलमूर्धजाः॥
en: With sleep and intoxication, were reeling those fair ones of beautiful countenances, having their hairs with garlands disbanded and their persons wet with perspiration.

sa: अर्करश्मिप्रतीकाशां काञ्चनीं मणिविग्रहाम्।७५।। सुग्रीवाय जं दिव्यां प्रायच्छन्मनुजाधिपः।
en: Thereupon that lord of men conferred upon Sugriva a celestial garland brilliant like the rays of the Sun and crested with gold and jewels.

sa: तदाश्चर्यमथो दृष्ट्वा देवदानवसंनिधौ। प्रहर्षितौ सुसंरब्धौ मृत्युकालौ बभूवतुः॥
en: Witnessing this wonder in the presence of the deities and Dānavas, both Death and Time were fixed with wrath and were filled with delight.

sa: अथ संस्कारसंपन्नो हनूमान्सविचोत्तमः। उवाच वचनं श्लक्ष्णमर्थवन्मधुरं लघु॥
en: There upon spoke Hanumān, the foremost of the counsellors and well versed in Šāstras, in accents sweet, glorious and fraught with a high value.

sa: पतिता सागरे चाहं तिमिनक्रझषाकुले। भवेयमाशु विवशा यादसामन्नमुत्तमम्॥
en: No sooner I shall fall down into the ocean infested with fish and other animals than I shall be an excellent food to them.

sa: इदमुक्तवती देवी जानकी पुरुषर्षभ। पूर्ववृत्तमभिज्ञानं चित्रकूटे यथातथम्॥
en: O foremost of men, the worshipful Jānaki, related as a token, all the incidents at the Mount Citrakūta from the beginning to the end.

sa: महोदरा महादंष्ट्रा घोररूपा महाबलाः। युद्धाभिमनसः सर्वे हनूमद्ग्रहणोन्मुखाः॥
en: Having huge bellies, and large teeth, of dreadful form, and possessed of unwieldy strength, all eager to engage in the conflict and take Hanuman.

sa: उत्पतद्भिर्द्विजगणैः पक्षैर्वातैः समाहताः। अनेकवर्णा विविधा मुमुचुः पुष्पवृष्टयः॥
en: And blown against by the wind caused by the wings of the birds as they flew upwards, various and variegated trees showered down blossoms.

sa: दृश्यतेऽसौ महान्सीते सविद्युदिव तोयदः॥ ऋष्यमूको गिरिवरः काञ्चनैर्धातुभिर्वृतः।
en: Do you behold there, O Sītā, the huge and foremost mount Rishyamuka abounding in gold and various metals, like to clouds accompanied with lightnings.

sa: उदीक्षमाणा गगनं केच्चिनेत्रेषु ताडिताः। शनैर्विविशुरन्योन्यं पेतुश्च जगतीतले॥
en: Some looking at the sky were struck at their eyes. They gradually began to hide themselves in each other and drop to the earth.

sa: ततः प्रासादशिखरं शैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम्। चक्राम राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then the powerful son of Vāli with his legs attacked the top of that palace, elevated like a hill, of the lord of Rākşasas.

sa: ततस्तु राजानमुदीक्ष्य दीनं शोकार्णवे संपरिपुप्लुवानम्। स्तमिन्द्रजिद्वाक्यमिदं बभाषे॥
en: Thereupon, seeing the king afflicted, and sunk in a sea of sorrow, that foremost of carwarriors-son to the Räkşasa king—Indrajit, addressed (his sire), saying.

sa: नह्यल्पकारणे सुप्तं बोधयिष्यति मादृशम्। तदाख्यातार्थतत्त्वेन मत्प्रबोधनकारणम्।७० ॥
en: One does not awaken my like for a light cause. therefore do you give the real truth of the cause of your awakening me.

sa: परिघान्पट्टिशांश्चैव शरखङ्गपरश्वधान्। शरीरान्तकरान्सर्वे चिक्षिपुर्वानरान्प्रति।। वानराश्च द्रुमाञ्छैलानराक्षसान्प्रति चिक्षिपुः॥
en: They all threw at the monkeys life-destroying Parighas, pattisas, arrows, daggers and Parasvadhas. And the monkeys too threw crags and trees at the Rākşasas.

sa: सुहृदामर्थकृच्छ्रेषु युक्तं बुद्धिमता सदा। समर्थेनोपसंदेष्टुं शाश्वतीं भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: It behove him, who desires for perpetual wealth, and is intelligent and capable of giving sound counsels, to advise his friends in difficult matters.

sa: गत्वा सौम्य दशग्रीवं ब्रूहि मद्वचनात्कपे॥ लङ्घयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कां भयं त्यक्त्वा गतव्यथः। भ्रष्टश्रीकं गतैश्वर्यं मुमूर्षानष्टचेतनम्॥
en: O mild one, going to the Ten-necked one, tell him in my words, Bounding over the deep and casting off fear and dejection, I have laid siege to the city of Lankā; and have reft you of your prosperity and your wealth; and rendered you moribund and senseless.

sa: देवदानवगन्धर्यक्षराक्षसपनगैः। अवध्यत्वं मया प्रोक्तं मानुषेभ्यो न याचितम्॥
en: You are incapable of being slain by deities and Danavas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and serpents. But you have not asked for immunity from men.

sa: अहं सुग्रीवसंदेशादिह प्राप्तस्तवान्तिके। राक्षसेश हरीशस्त्वां भ्राता कुशलमब्रवीत्॥
en: I have come to you at you command of Sugriva, O lord of Raksasas. Your brother, the king of monkeys, enquires after your welfare.

sa: तत्र दिव्योपमं मुख्यं स्फाटिकं रत्नभूषितम्। अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान् ददर्श शयनासनम् ॥ दान्तकाञ्चनचित्राङ्गैवैदूर्यैश्च वरासनैः। महार्हास्तरणोपेतैरुपपन्नं महाधनैः॥
en: And there Hanumán employed in looking around saw a grand dais made of crystal; and embellished with jewels; comparable to one belonging to the celestial regions; furnished with superb and costly sofas, having their parts painted and composed of ivory, gold, and lapis lazulis; with highly precious canopies.

sa: कृतोदकः शुचिर्भूत्वा काले हुतहुताशनः। देवागारं जगामाशु पुण्यमिक्ष्वाकुसेवितम्॥
en: Washing his mouth, being purified and offering oblation to fire, he entered the holy room of the tutelary deity much honoured by the Iksvākus.

sa: भैरवाभिरुते भीमे युद्धे वानररक्षसाम्। भूतैर्बहुभिराकाशं विस्मितैरावृतं बभौ॥
en: In that terrific encounter of the monkeys and the Rākşasas resounding with dreadful roars, the welkin was covered with innumerable beings seized with wonderment.

sa: तन्मां रामकृतोद्योगं त्वन्निमित्तमिहागतम्॥ सुग्रीवसचिवं देवि बुद्ध्यस्व पवनात्मजम्।
en: Do you know me as the Wind-god's son, the counsellor of Sugrīva, who am engaged in Rāma's service and have come here for you.

sa: ऋक्षवानरवीराणामनीकानि प्रहर्षय। विशल्यौ कुरु चाप्येतौ सादितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: Do you cheer up this host consisting of bears and monkeys; and do you also heal the wounds of these two tormented by them.

sa: वज्रनिष्पेषसदृशं प्रासस्याभिनिपातनम्। न शेकुर्वानराः सोढुं ते विनेदुर्महास्वनम्॥
en: The monkeys were ill fitted to bear the impetus of that präśa having the touch of thunder itself; and they raised a loud cry.

sa: प्रच्छादयन्तौ गगनं शरजालैर्महाबलौ। तमस्त्रैः सूर्यसंकाशैनँव पस्पर्शतुः शरैः॥
en: Those two highly powerful heroes could not even touch his person with their arrows resembling the Sun albeit they covered the whole welkin therewith.

sa: श्रुत्वा जाम्बवतो वाक्यमुवाचेदं विभीषणः। आर्यपुत्रावतिक्रम्य कस्मात्पृच्छसि मारुतिम्॥
en: Hearing Jambavan's speech, Vibhisana said, “Why, passing by the son of the high and mighty,* did you enquire after the wind-god's offsprmg? *Vide Hamlet.

sa: तमाशीभिः प्रशस्ताभिः प्रेषयामास रावणः। शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैः सैन्यैश्चापि वरायुधैः॥
en: Rāvana sent him with choice benedictions, while he caused kettle-drums and conchs to be sounded and force equipped with excellent weapons, to accompany Kumbhakarņa.

sa: अन्तर्धानगतेनाजौ यत्त्वया चरितस्तदा। तस्कराचरितो मार्गो नैष वीरनिषेवितः॥
en: That your had rendered yourself invisible in the field of conflict, was the work of a thief, and not the way of a hero.

sa: विहङ्गसङ्घींनास्ते स्कन्धमात्राशया द्रुमाः। बभूवुरगमाः सर्वे मारुतेन विनिर्धताः॥
en: And moved by the Wind god's offspring, the trees with their trunks left, and forsaken by the fowls were incapable of harbouring any creatures.

sa: दृश्यतेऽसौ महान्सीते सविद्युदिव तोयदः॥ ऋष्यमूको गिरिवरः काञ्चनैर्धातुभिर्वृतः।
en: Do you behold there, O Sītā, the huge and foremost mount Rishyamuka abounding in gold and various metals, like to clouds accompanied with lightnings.

sa: धर्षितायास्त्वयानार्य न मे जीवितमिष्यते। रक्षस्तस्मात्प्रवेक्ष्यामि पश्यतस्ते हुताशनम्॥
en: You object, having been outraged by you I wish not to live. Therefore, O Raksasa, I will enter into fire in your very presence.

sa: सर्वेषां नः प्रभुश्चैव भविष्यसि महाबल। अथाब्रवीद्दशग्रीवो मातामहमुपस्थितम्॥
en: O you endowed with prodigious strength, you shall be the lord of all. Then the Ten-necked one addressed his maternal grand-father, who was present.

sa: राघवस्तु रथं दिव्यमिन्द्रदत्तं शिखिप्रभम्॥ अनुज्ञाप्य महाबाहुर्मातलिं प्रत्यपूजयत्।
en: Rāghava, having long arms, permitting the charioteer Mātali to take back the celestial car bright as the sky sent by Indra, honoured him greatly.

sa: तमायान्तं महेष्वासं सात्यकिं युद्धदुर्मदम्। राधेयो दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यदजिह्मगैः॥
en: At this juncture, Satyaki that scion of the Dasarha race, advanced to the rescue of the puissant Dhristadyumna, shooting numerous arrows (in all directions).

sa: तदस्य क्षत्रियास्तत्र सर्व एवाभ्यपूजयन्। यदर्जुनहषीकेशौ प्रत्युद्यातौ न्यवारयत्॥
en: Then all the Kshatriyas present there applauded him, inasmuch as he ventured to rush against Arjuna and Hrishikesha with a view to oppose them.

sa: प्रयत्नज्ञो हि कौन्तेयो नखमांसान्तरेषुभिः। स वेदनाभिराविग्नः पलायनपरायणः॥
en: Then your warriors, beholding Duryodhana that foremost of bowmen, involved in great danger and afflicted with the arrows of Dhananjaya, rushed to his rescue.

sa: इन्द्रायुधसवर्णाभाः पताका भरतर्षभ॥ दोधूयमाना रथिनां शोभयन्ति महारथान्।
en: Resembling the rainbow in hue, those streamers, 0 best of the Bharata race. Belonging to those car-warriors, fluttering in the air, beautified their cars.

sa: बभ्रमुश्चस्खलुश्चान्ये पेतुर्मम्लुस्तथाऽपरे। एवं तत् कुञ्जरानीकं युयुधानेन पीडितम्॥
en: Some then began to roll about, some limped, some fell down and some became pale and cheerless. Thus that elephant division afflicted by Yuyudhana.

sa: पृथिवी धर्मराजाय शमेनैव प्रदीयताम्। यावत् फाल्गुननाराचा निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभाः॥
en: Then let the sovereignty of the earth be given to king Yudhishthira the virtuous shafts of Phalguna looking like snakes divested of their slough.

sa: मोहिता बाणजालेन भारद्वाजेन संयुगे। ऊरुग्राहगृहीतानां पञ्चालानां महारथाः॥
en: Confounded by the net-work of arrows shot by Bharadvaja's son, the Panchala warriors then thought themselves to be seized by the thighs by alligators.

sa: तेषु प्रक्षीयमाणेषु चेदिमुख्येषु सर्वशः। पञ्चाला: समकम्पन्त द्रोणसायकपीडिताः॥
en: When the best warrior of the Chedis were becoming reduced in number, the Panchalas began to tremble, being afflicted by the shafts of Drona.

sa: भीष्मद्रोणवतिक्रम्य धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। नान्यतो भयमादत्त विना कर्णान्महारथात्॥
en: Having worsted Bhisma and Drona, the very virtuous king Yudhishthira entertained not so much apprehension from any body else as he did from Karna.

sa: तां कर्णभुजनिर्मुक्तामकैवैश्वानरप्रभाम्। शक्तिं वियति चिच्छेद भीमः सप्तभिराशुगैः॥
en: But as that lance of the radiance of fire or the sun was coursing through the skies, Bhima cut it off with seven swift-arrows.

sa: अभ्यद्रवद् भीमसेनं व्यासक्तं विकिरज्छरैः। स भीमं नवभिर्बाणैरश्वानष्टभिरापर्यत्॥
en: He wounded Bhima with nine, his horses with eight, his charioteer with six, his standard with three, then again himself (Bhima) with seven shafts.

sa: परस्परं वीक्षमाणौ क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनौ। युयुधाते महावी? शक्रवैरोचनी यथा॥
en: Looking at each other with eyes red in rage, those two heroes of mighty energy fought on with each other like Indra and Virochana.

sa: ते समासाद्य कौन्तेयमावृण्वशरवृष्टिभिः। पर्वतं वारिधाराभिः प्रावृषीव वलाहकाः॥
en: Encountering the son of Kunti, they poured their arrowy torrents on him, like clouds pouring rain on the mountain breast during the rainy season.

sa: समाप्लवन् द्विषत्सैन्यं लोकं मानोरिवांशवः। अथापरे समुत्सृष्टा विशिखास्तिग्मतेजसः॥
en: Covered over the hostile troops, like the rays of the sun covering over the earth. Similarly other arrows of fierce energy shot by Arjuna.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नपिता राजन् द्रोणमेवाभ्यवर्तत। द्रौपदेया महेष्वासा राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः॥
en: The father of Dhrishtadyumna, O king, marched against Drona. Those mighty wielders of bow viz., the (five) sons of Draupadi and the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha.

sa: राजन्ननिशमत्यन्तं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं शरार्चिषम्। मण्डलीकृतधन्वानं तपन्तमिव भास्करम्॥
en: O king, seeing Drona incessantly discharge fierce arrows like sparks of fire from his bow drawn to a circle and like the scorching sun.

sa: तं दहन्तमनीकानि शरैराशीविषोपमैः। तेषु राजसहस्रेषु पाण्डवेयेषु भारत॥
en: While engaged in consuming the forces with arrows (fierce) as poisonous snakes, among those thousands of kings on the side of the Pandavas, OBharata.

sa: पश्यैतां द्रवती सेनां कर्णसायकपीडिताम्। कार्तिकेयेन विध्वस्तामासुरी पृतनामिव॥
en: Behold, the (enemy's) army, oppressed with the arrows of Karna, is, like the Asura force afflicted by Kartikeya, running away in all the directions).

sa: स नुन्नोऽर्जुनबाणौघेराचितः शल्यको यथा॥ जीवितार्थमभिप्रेप्सुः कृपस्य रथमारुहत्।
en: Afflicted with (Arjuna's) darts, that most exalted of men hastily jumped down from his steedless car and got up to the car of Kripa.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरः क्रुद्धस्तावकानां महाबलम्। शरैर्विद्रावयामास भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Then, Yudhishthira, filled with rage, began to crush the troops of the son of Bharadvaja with in the the very presence of Bharadvaja's son.

sa: भीमसेनमथायान्तं व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम्। स्वयं दुर्योधनो राजा प्रतीपं मृत्युमाव्रजत्॥
en: Duryodhana himself rushed against Bhimasena, the foremost of car-warriors, in that engagement, who was advancing on his car (against Drona) like the grim Destroyer.

sa: रौद्रेण चित्रपक्षण विवृताक्षेण कूजता। ध्वजेनोच्छ्रितदण्डेन गृध्रराजेन राजता॥
en: And it was furnished with a tall standard on which sat a fierce vulture of spotted wings, having eyes wide open and shrieking incessantly.

sa: सोऽन्यद् धनुः समादाय क्रोधरक्तेक्षणःश्वसन्। अभ्यद्रवच्छरौघैस्तं धृष्टद्युम्नं महाबलम्॥
en: But Karna did not brook that severance of his bow even as a fierce lion does not brook the chopping off of its tail.

sa: तमर्जुनस्तु विंशत्या विव्याध युधि भारत। अथेतरान् महेष्वासांसिभिस्रिभिरविध्यत॥
en: Him, O Bharata, Arjuna pierced in battle with a set of twenty shafts and other mighty bowmen of his division with three shafts each.

sa: ततः पार्थोऽप्यसंम्भ्रान्तस्तदा प्रतिजनिवान्। ब्रह्मास्रेणैव राजेन्द्र ततः सर्वमशीशमत्॥
en: Thereupon, O foremost of kings, Pirthas' son, with the other Brahma weapons, destroyed that weapon of Drona and then all things were again pacified.

sa: तेषामस्राणि दिव्यानि संहितानि महात्मनाम्। वारयामास विधिवद् दिव्यैरस्त्रैर्महामृधे॥
en: In that great battle, with his various celestial weapons, he duly baffled the celestial weapons of his high-souled opponents, that were aimed at him.

sa: सवसातीशिबींश्चैव बाह्रीकान् कौरवानपि। रक्षिष्यमाणान् संग्रामे द्रोणं व्यधमदच्युतः॥
en: That warrior of unfading renown, began to consume the Vasatis, the Shinis, the Valhikas and the Kurus who were then engaged in protecting Drona.

sa: क्षुत्पिपासापरिम्लानास्ते योधास्तव भारत। आदित्येनेव संतप्ता भृशं विमनसोऽभवन्॥
en: Those warriors of yours, O Bharata, worn out with hunger and thirst and scorched by the burning rays of the sun were exceedingly dejected.

sa: तत उत्स्स्रष्टुकामांस्तानस्राण्यालक्ष्य पाण्डवः। भीमसेनोऽब्रवीद् राजन्निदं संहर्षयन् वचः॥
en: But Bhimasena the son of Pandu, beholding the Pandavas about to abandon their weapons had thus spoken, O king, gladdening the hearts of all.

sa: विवर्धमानमालक्ष्य तदा भीमविक्रमम्। पाण्डुसैन्यमृते भीमं समहद् भयमाविशत्॥
en: Beholding that weapon of great energy increasing in its fury, the troops of the Pandavas were filled with fear with the exception of Bhima.

sa: दृष्ट्वा पार्थांश्च संग्रामे युद्धाय समुपस्थितान्। नारायणास्रनिर्मुक्तांश्चरतः पृतनामुखे॥
en: Beholding the Parthas, rally for the fight and freed from the influence of the Narayana weapon and career at the head of their divisions.

sa: तस्य दुर्वारवीर्यस्य सत्यसंधस्य धीमतः। बाह्वोर्द्रविणमक्षय्यमद्य द्रक्ष्यथ संयुगे॥
en: Do you behold today in battle the inexhaustible strength of arms of that intellectual one, who is of unsubdued energy and of fixed purpose.

sa: जयत्सेनस्तथा राजञ्जारासंधिर्महाबलः। मागधो निहत: संख्ये सौभद्रेण महात्मना॥
en: Then again, O monarch, the Magadha prince Jayatsena, the most powerful son of Jarasandha, was slain in battle by the loftyminded son of Subhadra.

sa: योऽजयत् सर्वकाम्बोजानावन्त्यान् केकयैः सह। गान्धारान् मद्रकान् मत्स्यास्त्रिगर्तास्तङ्गणाशकान्॥१८
en: That hero (Karna) had subdued the unusually powerful and invincible enemies namely the Gandharvas, the Madrakas, the Matsyas, the Trigartas, the Tanganas the Shashas.

sa: कर्णोऽपि राजन् सम्प्राप्य सैनापत्यमरिंदमः। योगामाज्ञापगमास सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति॥
en: O monarch, Karna, the subduer of enemies, having obtained this leadership, ordered for arranging the troops in battle-array towards the rising of the Sun.

sa: न चेदरक्षिष्य इमं जनं भयाद् द्विषद्भिरेवं बलिभिः प्रपीडितम्। तथाभविष्यद् विषतां प्रमोदनं यथा हतेष्वेष्विह नोऽरिसूदन॥
en: O smiter of enemies, had you not protected those people from terror, who had greatly been oppressed by the most powerful foes, then there would have been immense gratification amongst the antagonists, even as there had been a great merriment amongst us on the slaughter of the enemies.

sa: महामेघं महाघोरं दर्दुरः प्रतिनर्दसि। कामतोयप्रदं लोके नरपर्जन्यमर्जुनम्॥
en: Your roaring at Arjuna, the deity of clouds among men, like that of frog at a dreadful huge cloud discharging copious showers of rain.

sa: हंसस्तु मृदुनैकेन विक्रान्तुमुपचक्रमे॥ प्रत्यहीयत काकाच मुहूर्तमिव मारिष।
en: With one kind of gentle motion the swan began to roar up. For a moment, O Marisha, the crow seemed to have defeated him.

sa: ततः शङ्खसहस्राणां निःस्वनो हृदयङ्गम। प्रादुरासीदुभयतो भेरीशब्दश्च दारुणः॥
en: Then there arose from both the armies the sound of a thousand conches capable striking terror into hearts as well as that of bugles.

sa: स रथंस्त्रिशतं हत्वा चेदीनामनिवर्तिनाम्। राधेयो निशितैर्बाणैस्ततोऽभ्याईद् युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Having broken down thirty chariots of the Chedis who never return from the battle-field the son of Radha pierced Yudhishthira with many sharp arrows.

sa: रथाः पञ्चशताश्चान्ये हादिनचर्मवर्मिणः। भीममभ्यद्रवन् जन्तः शरपूगैः समन्ततः॥
en: Then five hundred car-warriors, clad in excellent coats of mail, fell upon Bhima with loud shouts discharging a shower of arrows on all sides.

sa: द्रौणायनिशरच्छन्नं न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन। बाणभूतमभूत् सर्वमायोधनशिरो महत्॥
en: When the sky was covered with the arrows of Drona's son nothing could be perceived. The space before the warriors was filled with arrows.

sa: स पञ्चदश नाराचाश्वसतः पन्नगानिव॥ जिघांसुर्भरतश्रेष्ठं धृष्टद्युम्नो व्यपासृजत्।
en: Then, O chief of Bharatas, the hero Dhristadyumna, bent bent upon killing him, discharged fifteen sharp shafts, called Narachas, which looked like hissing serpents.

sa: ततोऽभवत् पुनर्युद्धं घोरमत्यर्थमद्भुतम्॥ नानावस्थाश्च योधानां बभूवस्तत्र युद्धयताम्।
en: And the battle, that was fought after this, was exceedingly terrible and awe-inspiring and the fate of each of the fighting combatants changed repeatedly.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु पार्थेन कृष्णो मतिमतां वरम्। धनंजयमुवाचेदं प्राप्तकालमरिंदमम्॥
en: Thus addressed by Partha, Krishna, the subduer of his enemies, said to Dhananjaya, the foremost of the wise, the following suitable to the occasion.

sa: श्चकार शत्रूनपसव्यमातुरान्। ततः प्रयातं त्वरितं धनंजय शतक्रतुं वृत्रनिजघ्नुषं यथा॥ समन्वधावन् पुनरुत्थितैर्ध्वजै रथैः सुयुक्तैरपरे युयुत्सवः।
en: Then Keshava, leaving the distressed enemies on he right side, drove the chariot onward and Dhananjaya when going quickly like Satamanyu (Indra) at the time of killing Vritra was followed by other great warriors with lofty banners and excellent chariots all desirous of gaining a name in battle.

sa: असृड्यासवसाभिश्च तृप्तिमभ्यागता गदा। अस्थीन्यप्यश्नती तस्थौ कालरात्रीव दुर्दशा॥
en: That mace, appeared with drinking blood, also eating flesh, bones and marrow and became terrible to look at like the black night of death.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। यथापृच्छत् पद्मयोनिमेतदेव शतक्रतुः॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old discourse between him who sprang from the primeval lotus and him who performed a hundred sacrifices.

sa: वायोरपि विकुर्वाणाज्ज्योतिर्भवति भास्वरम्। रोचिष्णु जायते शुक्रं तद्रूपगुणमुच्यते॥
en: From Wind also, by modification, originates Light endued with effulgence. Beautiful and called also Shukram, it is thus created, possessing the attribute of Form.

sa: पण्यैश्च बहुभिर्युक्तां सुविभक्तमहापथाम्। अश्वै रथैस्तथा नागैर्योधैश्च बहुभिर्युताम्॥
en: The city was traversed by several broad roads, lined with innumerable shops. It was also covered over with innumerable horses, cars, elephants and warriors.

sa: तमेकाकिनमासाद्य धार्तराष्ट्र महाबलम्। वियूथमिव मातङ्गं समहष्यन्त पाण्डवाः॥
en: Verily beholding that powerful son of yours standing alone like a prince of elephants separated from the herd, the Pandavas were filled with joy.

sa: निकृतस्य नरैरन्यैर्शातिरेव परायणम्। नान्यैनिकारं सहते ज्ञातिव्रते: कथञ्चन॥
en: Kinsmen are the refuge of one who is attacked by others, for kinsmen can never bear to see a kinsman assailed by other people.

sa: आक्षेपणेन चैवासेस्त्रिधा रक्तोक्षितोऽभवत्॥ तस्य लोहितरक्तस्य दीप्तखड्गस्य युध्यतः।
en: Covered as he was with blood, and holding a blazing sword, his form, as he moved about in battle, became exceedingly terrible and superhuman.

sa: भेरीशङ्गमृदङ्गानां कार्मुकाणां च निःस्वनः॥ बभूव धार्तराष्ट्राणां सिंहनादरवस्तथा।
en: Then there arose the leonine shout of the sons of Dhritarashtra accompanied by the sound of bugles, conch, mridangas and the twang of bows.

sa: ममैवं क्लिश्यमानस्य नारदोभयतः सदा। वक्तुमर्हसि यच्छ्रेयो ज्ञातीनामात्मनस्तथा॥
en: I am thus, O Narada, afflicted by both. You should tell me that which is for the behoof of both myself and my kinsmen.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। यथा सेनजितं विप्रः कश्चिदेत्याब्रवीत् सुहृत्॥
en: Regarding it is mentioned the old story of the speech that a twice-born friend of his, coming to Senajit's court, made to that king.

sa: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य जपन्नेव महायशाः। ददर्शाद्भुतसंकाशं पुलस्त्यमृषिसत्तमाम्॥
en: One day when the greatly illustrious one was thus engaged (in observing his vow), he saw that foremost of Rishis, Pulastya of wonderful appearance.

sa: कूपवीनाहवेलायामपश्यत महागजम् ॥ षड्वक्त्रं कृष्णशुक्लं च द्विषट्कपदचारिणम्।
en: The elephant, was dark coloured and had six faces and twelve feet. And the animal gradually approached that pit overgrown with creepers and trees.

sa: प्रादुरासीन्महाञ्छब्दः खे शरीरंदृशयते। सर्वेषु राजन् देशेषु तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: There were loud roars though no body could be seen in this earth; and in all countries, Oking there occurred the same strange things.

sa: अथोत्क्रुष्टं महेष्वासैर्धार्तराष्ट्रैर्महारथैः। प्रतिज्ञाते फाल्गुनस्य वधे कर्णेन संयुगे॥
en: When Karna had thus vowed to kill Arjuna in battle those mighty car-warriors and bowmen, the sons of Dhritarashtra, sent up a loud shout.

sa: हरिणैश्चपलापाङ्गैर्हरिणीसहितैर्वनम्। सशष्पकवलैः श्रीमान् पथि दृष्ट्वा द्रुतं ययौ॥
en: When proceeding quickly, that handsome hero saw in the forest, deer of quick glances with grass in their mouth standing along with their mates.

sa: कृष्णसम्माननार्थं च नगरं समलंकृतम्। बभूव राजमार्गश्च बहुरत्नसमाचितः॥
en: For paying honour to Krishna the city was well ornamented and the public roads were decked with diverse sorts of gems and precious stones.

sa: पुत्रोऽस्याञ्जनपर्वा तु महाबलपराक्रमः। शैनेयश्च महाबाहुः सहायो रणकोविदः॥
en: And his son Anjanaparva, of great strength and prowess, and the descendant of Shini's race, well versed in fighting, and who is your ally,

sa: अर्जुनेन तपस्तप्त्वा गन्धर्वेभ्यो यदाहृतम्। तुम्बुरुप्रमुखेभ्यो वै तेनामोहयताहितान्॥
en: This weapon was secured by Arjuna from the Gandharvas Tamburu and others, through bis ascetic austerities. Now Abhimanyu confounded his foes with that weapon.

sa: स्तनावपतितौ पीनौ सुजातौ शुभलक्षणौ। अभ्यवर्षत पाञ्चाली दुःखजैरश्रुबिन्दुभिः॥
en: The tears of the Panchala princess, the outpourings of her grief, washed her deep, plump and graceful breasts, which were crowned with auspicious marks.

sa: विद्यात् तु षोडशैतानि दैवतानि विभागशः। देहेषु ज्ञानकर्तारमुपासीनमुपासते।॥
en: These sixteen, existing in their respective forms, should be known as god. These adore Him who creates all knowledge and lives within the body.

sa: आशीविषैः कृष्णसीमसेनपदंशयत्। सर्वेष्वेवाङ्गदेशेषु च ममार च शत्रुहा॥
en: It was he (Duryodhana) who caused venomous snakes to bite all over the body of Bhimasena, but that slayer of foes did not die.

sa: राजसांस्तामसांश्चैव नित्यं दोषान् विवर्जयेत्। सात्त्विकं मार्गमास्थाय पश्येदात्मानमात्मना॥
en: One should always renounce faults produced by the qualities of Rajas and Tamas. Following the path of Sattva, one should see Self by Self.

sa: पुत्र उवाच धीरः किंस्वित्तात कुर्यात्प्रजानन् क्षिप्रं ह्यायुर्धश्यते मानवानाम्। पितस्तदाचक्ष्व यथार्थयोगं मामनुपूव्यां येन धर्मं चरेयम्॥
en: The son said — Seeing that the lease of human life is passing away so very speedily, what should a wise man do? O father, tell me the duties which one should perform, without failing to mention the fruits. Having heard you, I wish to practise those duties.

sa: महायोगगतिं त्वन्यां व्यासोत्थाय महातपाः॥ निमेषान्तरमात्रेण शुकाभिपतनं ययौ।
en: Following the subtile path of high Yoga, Vyasa of austere penances, reached within the twinkling of the eye that place whence Shuka first started.

sa: मित्रोऽथ वरुणश्चैव यमोऽथ धनदस्तथा॥ ते पृथग्दर्शनस्तस्य संविदन्ति तथैकताम्। एकस्य विद्धि देवस्य सर्वं जगदिदं वशे॥
en: He is Mitra, He is Varuna, He is Yama, He is Kuvera—the lord of riches. Although the Ritwijas seem to see Him as separate, He is, however, known to them as one and the same. Know that this entire universe is under the control of One divine Being.

sa: कृत्तिकास्तस्य नक्षत्रमसेरग्निश्च दैवतम्। रोहिणी गोत्रमस्याथ रुद्रश्च गुरुरुत्तमः॥
en: The constellation under which the sword was born in Kritika. Agni is its god, and Rohini is its Gotra. Rudra is its great preceptor.

sa: भारार्तामप्रहृष्टां च दुःखितां संनिमज्जतीम्। अथादितेयाः संत्रस्ता ब्रह्माणमिदमब्रुवन्॥
en: The Adityas, stricken with fear, went to Brahman, and said,-How O Brahman, shall we continue to put up with these oppressions of the Danavas.

sa: करोति भगवान् रूपमाटव्यशबराण्यपि। कूर्मो मत्स्यस्तथा शङ्खः प्रवालाकुरभूषणः॥
en: He assumes the forms of tortoises and fishes and conchs. He assumes the form of those corals which are used as ornaments by men.

sa: गतेषु त्रिदिवौकःसु ब्रह्मैकः पर्यवस्थितः। दिदृक्षुर्भगवन्तं तमनिरुद्धतनौ स्थितम्॥
en: After the celestiats had left that place, only Brahman remained there, desirous of seeing the great Deity then living in the form of Aniruddha.

sa: ततो वर्षसहस्रान्ते वितानमकरोत् प्रभुः। विधिना कल्पदृष्टेन यथावच्चोपपादितम्॥
en: After the expiration of a thousand years, the powerful lord made arrangements for a grand sacrifice according to the ordinances prescribed in the scriptures.

sa: व्याधिभिर्मथ्यमानानां त्यजतां विपुलं धनम्। वेदनां नापकर्षन्ति यतमानाश्चिकित्सकाः॥
en: If when men are attacked by diseases, they wish to spend even immense riches, physicians with their best efforts fail to lessen their sufferings.

sa: दिव्यं वैयाघ्रपद्यस्य उपमन्योर्महात्मनः। पूजितं देवगन्धर्वैाझ्या लक्ष्या समावृतम्॥
en: There, on that foremost of mountains, I saw many wonderful spectacles. I saw an excellent, wonderful, and agreeable hermitage for the practice of penances.

sa: त्वं हि ज्ञानानिधिविप्रेसच्यसे वेदपारगैः। ऋषिभिश्च महाभागैर्यतिभिश्च महात्मभिः॥
en: Brahmans conversant with the Vedas, speak of you as on Ocean of knowledge. Highly blessed Rishis and Yatis of great souls do the Salme.

sa: यत् त्वसंतोषसंयुक्तमप्रीतिकरमात्मनः। प्रवृत्तं रज इत्येवं ततस्तदपि चिन्तयेत्॥
en: Whatever state of consciousness exists united with any feeling of discontent or depression should be considered as the outcome of the quality of Darkness.

sa: परस्परस्य विद्यां वै त्वं नबोधानुपूर्वशः। यथोक्तमृषिभिस्तात सांख्यस्याभिनिदर्शनम्॥
en: Listen to me first as I Tell you what is Vidya among success sets of other things, as explained in the Sankhya Philosophy. essences

sa: एतदेव हि कार्पण्यं समग्रमसमीक्षितम्। यचेत्सममीक्षयैव स्याद्भवेत्तस्मिस्ततो गुणः॥
en: An ill-judged thing produces enough of miserics. That, on the other hand, which is done with the help of sound judgement yields excellent results.

sa: तावाप्लुत्य यतात्मानौ कृतजप्यौ समासतः। नद्याः पुलिनमासाद्य सूक्ष्मकाञ्चनवालुकम्॥
en: The Rishi and the god, both of whom had perfectly controlled their minds, finished their ablutions, and having completed their silent recitations, sat together.

sa: भीष्म उवाच हृतार्थो यक्ष्यमाणश्व सर्ववेदान्तगश्च यः। आचार्यपितृकार्यार्थं स्वाध्यायार्थमथापि च॥ एते वै दृष्टा ब्राह्मणा धर्मभिक्षवः। निःस्वेभ्यो देयमेतेभ्यो दानं विद्या च भारत॥ साधवो
en: Bhishma said Wealth and knowledge, O Bharata, should be given to such pious and impoverished Brahmanas as have been robbed of their wealth (by thieves), as are engaged in the celebration of sacrifices, as are well-read in all the Vedas, and as are desirous of acquiring the merit of righteousness, so that they may satisfy their duties to preceptors and the Pitris, and spend their days in reciting and studying the scriptures.

sa: तस्मात् सम्यक् परीक्षेत दोषानज्ञानसम्भवान्। अज्ञानप्रभवं दुःखमहंकारं परित्यजेत्॥
en: All faults, begotten of Ignorance should be closely examined and the idea of Self, which originates from Ignorance, and creates misery, should be avoided.

sa: न बिभेति परो यस्मान्न बिभेति पराच्च यः। यश्च नेच्छति न द्वेष्टि ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा।॥
en: When a person lives in such a way that another is not filled with fear on seeing him, and when a person is not himself filled with fear on seeing others, when a person ceases to cherish desire and malice, he is then said to attain to Brahma.

sa: बहुकल्याणमिच्छन्ति ईहन्ते पितरः सुतान्। तपसा दैवतेज्याभिर्वन्दनेन तितिक्षया॥
en: Fathers wish for sons for obtaining various kinds of blessings, and hoping they would perform penances and sacrifices, adore the gods, and practise renunciation.

sa: ततश्चित्राङ्गदधरं भर्तारं सान्वपश्यत॥ विमानस्थं सुकृतिभिः पूज्यमानं महात्मभिः।
en: She then saw her husband bedecked with bracelets, seated on a (celestial) car, and worshipped of many great and meritorious beings standing around him.

sa: ततः स तपसा युक्तः सर्वधर्मविधानवित्। नृपायानुग्रहमना मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus accosted Parashara, endued with great ascetic merit and conversant with the ordinances of every religion, said these words, desirous of favouring the king.

sa: धर्मार्थमोक्षसंयुक्तमितिहासमिमं शुभम्। श्रुत्वा मनुष्यः सततमिहामुत्र च मोदते॥
en: By frequently listening to this auspicious story fraught with virtue, profit, and emancipation, a man acquires happiness both in this world and the next.'

sa: अदूरे कान्यकुब्जस्य गङ्गायास्तीरमुत्तमम्। अश्वतीर्थे तदद्यापि मानवैः परिचक्ष्यते॥
en: Not far from Kanyakuvja, the sacred bank of Ganga is still famous among men as Ashvatirtha on account of the appearance of those horses.

sa: स्वभावात् सम्प्रवर्तन्ते निवर्तन्ते तथैव च। सर्वे भावास्तथाभावाः पुरुषार्थो न विद्यते॥ पुरुषार्थस्य चाभावे नास्ति कश्चिच्च कारकः। स्वयं न कुर्वतस्तस्य जातु मानो भवेदिह॥
en: All kinds of entities and non-entities come into being or cease on account of their own nature. No kind of personal exertion is necessary (for their production). In the absence of personal exertion it is clear that no personal agent exists for the production of all this that we perceive. But though the person never does anything, yet through the influence of Ignorance a consciousness regarding agency over spreads itself on it.

sa: दुःखिताः केचिदादाय बालमप्राप्तयौवनम्। कुलसर्वस्वभूतं वै रुदन्तः शोकविह्वला:॥
en: Violently agitated by grief and bewailing aloud, some of his kinsmen took up the little boy who was the only wealth of his family.

sa: यादसामसृजन्नाथं वरुणं च जलेश्वरम्। वासवं सर्वदेवानामध्यक्षमकरोत् प्रभुः॥
en: He then created Varuna the lord of waters and governor of all acquatic animals. The powerful Vishnu made Vasava the king of all celestials.

sa: गन्धर्वाप्सरसो यक्षाः पन्नगाश्च महीपते। ब्रह्मक्षेत्रं महापुण्यमभिगच्छन्ति भारत॥
en: The Gandharvas, the Apsaras the Yakshas, the Nagas, O ruler of earth, O descendant of Bharata, all often go to that greatly sacred Brahmakshetra.

sa: सागरानूपजे देशे बहुमूलफलोदके। चितिं कृत्वा प्रवेक्ष्यामि समिद्धमरणीसुतम्॥
en: Preparing a funereal pile on a tract bordering on the sea, abounding in fruits, and flowers, and water, I will enter into flaming fire.

sa: आनयस्व चतुर्थेऽहनि पुण्यकं भविता ताभ्यामाबद्धाभ्यां शोभमाना ब्राह्मणान्यपरिवेष्टुमिच्छामि तत्संपादयस्व एवं हि कुर्वतःश्रेयो भविताऽन्यथा कुतःश्रेय इति॥
en: "And bring them here four days hence is a sacred day; on that day I wish to appear before the Brahmanas and distribute their food wearing those ear-rings. Do this, O Uttanka. If you be successful, good fortune will by yours. If not, what good can you expect?”

sa: शेषाणि चैव पानानि पानीयं चापि भोजने। सौहित्यं न च कर्तव्यं रात्रौ न च समाचरेत्॥
en: The residue of food and drink, as also the flowers with which one has adored the celestials, should never be used. Inviting a guest at night, one should never, with excessive courtesy, compel him to eat to his fill. Nor should one cat to his fill, at night.

sa: किंदत्तं कूपमासाद्य तिलप्रस्थं प्रदाय च॥ गच्छेत परमां सिद्धिमृणैर्मुक्तः कुरूद्वह। वेदीतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Going to the well, called Kindatta, he who throws into it one Prastha of sesamum, O perpetuator of the Kuru race, obtains the highest success and he is freed from all his debts. Bathing in the Vedi Tirtha,, one obtains the fruit of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वायुः सर्वगन्धवहः शुचिः॥ दिव्यान्युवाह पुष्पाणि कर्मण्याश्चौषधीस्तथा।
en: Meanwhile, a fragrant and pure breeze blew, carrying perfumes of celestial flowers, and of certain herbs and plants that were necessary on the occasion.

sa: अर्थी भवन्तमुपागतोऽस्मीति स एनमभिवाद्योवाच। भगवन्पौष्य:खल्वहं किं करवाणीति॥
en: “I have come to you and stand before you a petitioner.” King Paushya, returning his salutations said, "Sir, what shall I do for you?"

sa: आसां सर्वानवद्यानामातपेन परिश्रमात्। प्रम्लाननलिनाभानि भान्ति वक्त्राणि माधव॥
en: The faces of those beautiful damsels, O Madhava, exhausted with toil and scorched by thc rays of the Sun, are appearing like faded lotuses.

sa: स तमुन्मादयामास मृगरूपो निशाचरः। मृगैः परिवृतोऽथान्यैरदूरात् प्रत्यदृश्यत॥
en: And that ranger of the night, wearing the form of a deer, maddening Rāma, discovered himself (again) at a distance surrounded by (other) deer,

sa: प्रेक्षतस्त्वेव पार्थस्य वृष्णयन्धकवरस्त्रियः। जग्मुरादाय ते म्लेच्छाः समन्ताज्जनमेजय॥
en: Those Mlechcchas, however, O Janamejaya, in the very sight of Partha, retreated, taking away with the many foremost ladies of the Vrishnis and Andhakas.

sa: न चास्नातां स्त्रियं गच्छेत् तथायुर्विन्दते महत्॥ स्वे स्वे तीर्थे समाचम्य कार्ये समुपकल्पिते। त्रिः पीत्वाऽऽपो द्विः प्रमृज्य कृतशौचो भवेन्नरः।। इन्द्रियाणि सकृत्स्पृश्य त्रिरभ्युक्ष्य च मानवः।
en: One should never know a woman who has not bathed after the expiry of her menses. By avoiding such acts one succeeds in acquiring a long life. After washing the several limbs directed, in view of religious acts, one should wash his lips thrice, and once more twice. By doing this, one becomes purified and fit for religious rites. The several organs of sense should each be washed once, and water should also be sprinkled over the entire body.

sa: ततो युद्धमतीवासीन्मुहूर्तमिव भारत। भीरूणां त्रासजननं शूराणां हर्षवर्धनम्॥
en: Then there took place an encounter for the time being capable of striking terror unto the timid and increasing the delight of the heroes.

sa: पश्यामि बहुलान् राजन् वृक्षानुदकसंश्रयान्। सारसानां च निदिमत्रोदकमसंशयम्॥
en: "O king, I see numerous trees growing near water and also hear the cries of the Sarasas. Therefore, surely water must be somewhere here."

sa: ब्रह्मक्षत्रमहिंसन्तस्ते कोशं समपूरयन्। सुतीक्ष्णदण्डाः सम्प्रेक्ष्य पुरुषस्य बलाबलम्॥
en: And not bearing ill will towards Brahmaņas and Khatriyas, and filling the treasury, by inflicting punishments according lo the offences of the persons guilty.

sa: संवाहन्त्यः समापेतुर्नार्यो विपुललोचनाः। परिमृज्य तदान्योन्यं पाययन्ति वराङ्गनाः॥
en: And damsels furnished with expansive eyes, having wiped the persons (of the bathers), pressed their legs, and those magnificent women made them drink (wine).

sa: नैषधेनैवमुक्तस्तु पुष्करः प्रहसन्निवा ध्रुवमात्मजयं मत्वा प्रत्याह पृथिवीपतिम्॥
en: Brihadashva said: Having been thus addressed by the prince of the Nishadhas, Pushkara, with the assurance of his own success, answered the king smilingly.

sa: एवमुक्त्वाय॑मादाय भार्गवं भीमदर्शनम्। ऋषयो रामरामेति मधुरं वाक्यमब्रुवन्॥
en: Having said this, the saints offered Arghya to Bhrgu's son of dreadful appearance; and addressed him in soothing words, saying, 'Q Rāma! O Rāma.

sa: दृष्ट्वैवापततस्तांस्तु राघवः सायकैः शितैः॥ तीक्ष्णाग्रैः प्रतिजग्राह सम्प्राप्तानतिथीनिव।
en: And as Rāghava beheld them advance, he resisted them by means of sharp and keen-edged shafts, even as one receives guests that have come.

sa: ऋषिमांसाशनः क्रूरस्त्रासयन् वनगोचरान्। तदा रुधिरमत्तोऽहं वचरं दण्डकावनम्॥
en: I had a most ugly figure and was maddened with drinking blood, and all the animals of the forest were exceedingly frightened at me.

sa: इयं च माता ज्येष्ठा मे शीतवातावकर्शिता। घोरेण तपसा युक्ता देवी कच्चिन्न शोचति॥ हतान् पुत्रान् महावीर्यान् क्षत्रधर्मपरायणान्। नापध्यापति वा कच्चिदस्मान् पापकृतः सदा॥
en: Will, O king, her residence in the forest yield fruit? I hope this queen, who is my eldest mother, who is emaciated with (exposure to cold and wind and the toil of walking, and who is now given to the practice of serve austerities, no longer yields to grief for her children of great energy, of all whoin performing the duties of the Kshatriyas, have been killed on the field of battle.

sa: नृशंस्यामयशस्यां च दुःखां कापुरुषोचिताम्। यमेनमभिनन्देयुरमित्राः पुरुषं कृशम्॥
en: Compassionate leading to infamy and miserable which is suitable only for a coward; in such a case enemies rejoice over such a weak man.

sa: कश्चिदन्यः प्रियतरः कुन्तीपुत्रान्ममार्जुनात्। अनर्जुनमिमं लोकं मुहूर्तमपि दारुक॥
en: None among these is so dear to me as is Kunti's son Arjuna. O Daruka, bereft of Arjuna, for even a moment, this world.

sa: सक्तकर्मा कपिराजकेतुः। भीष्मं महात्माभिववर्ष तूर्णं शरौघजालैर्विमलैश्च भल्लैः॥
en: That illustrious ape-bannered hero then poured upon Bhishma that foremost of all wielders of arms a shower of sharp arrows and broad-headed polished shafts.

sa: दुर्योधन निबोधेदं शौरिणोक्तं महात्मना। आदत्स्व शिवमत्यन्तं योगक्षेमवदव्ययम्॥
en: "O Duryodhana, listen to this alive given by the great-souled Shouri; accept his words which are true, most beneficial, and conducive to our salvation.

sa: भरतस्तु वचः श्रुत्वा द्वाःस्थाद्रामसमीरितम्॥ उत्पपातासनात्तूर्णं पद्भ्यामेव महाबलः।
en: Hearing of the command of Rāma from the warder, the highly powerful Bharata at once got up from his seat and proceeded on foot.

sa: श्रुत्वा विनष्टान् वार्ष्णेयान् सभोजान्धककौकुरान्। पाण्डवाः शोकसंतप्ता वित्रस्तमनसोऽभवन्॥
en: Hearing that the Vrishnis along with the Bhojas and Andhakas and Kukuras had all been killed, the Pandavas, burning with grief, became highly moved.

sa: अकम्पनवधं श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धो वै राक्षसेश्वरः। किंचिद्दीनमुखश्चापि सचिवांस्तानुदैक्षत॥
en: Hearing that Akampana had been killed, the lord of Raksasas, overwhelmed with anger, with his face somewhat fallen, cast his eyes on his counsellors.

sa: आनुपूर्येण विधिना केशवेति पुनः पुनः। स चक्षुष्मान्समभवद्गोतमश्चाभवत्पुनः॥
en: Through the merit he acquired by uttering this name repeatedly, he became cured of his blindness and then passed by the name of Gotama.

sa: तत्रोपविष्टाः शोचन्तो न्यग्रोधस्य समीपतः। तमेवार्थमतिक्रान्तं कुरुपाण्डवयोः क्षयम्॥
en: Seated under that banian, they began to express their sorrow regarding the destruction that had taken place of both the Kurus and the Pandavas.

sa: तमासनगतं तत्र सर्वाः प्रकृतयस्तथा। ब्राह्मणा नैगमास्तत्र परिवार्योपतस्थिरे।॥
en: When he had taken his seat here, all the citizens, including the Brahmanas, and all the ministers of state, came and stood surrounding him.

sa: वातस्य तरसा वेगं निहन्तुमपि चोत्सहे। दहेयमपि संक्रुद्धस्तेजसाऽऽदित्यपावकौ॥
en: I can by my impetus resist the force of the wind. And when enraged, I can by my energy consume the Sun and Fire.

sa: संवेष्ट्यमाने लाङ्गले व्यवर्धत महाकपिः। शुष्कमिन्धनमासाद्य वनेष्विव हुताशनम्॥
en: Thereat, even as fire in a forest increase on getting dry fuel, the mighty monkey grew in dimensions on his tail being wrapped up.

sa: स्वर्णोद्देशस्त्वया राजन् सशरीरेण पार्थिव। मुहूर्तमनुभूतोऽसौ सभार्येण नृपोत्तम॥
en: O best of kings, for a little while I made you and your wife behold, in even your, earthly bodies, some sights of Heaven.

sa: एतौ तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ रिपुसैन्यं प्रधक्ष्यतः। गदाप्रासासिनाराचैस्तोमरैश्च करच्युतैः॥
en: These two best among men will consume the army of enemy with maces, bearded darts, swords, muskets and long shafts hurled from their hands.

sa: ततः प्रजाः सगन्धर्वाः सदेवासुरमानुषाः। प्रजापति समाधावन्दुःखिताश्च सुखेच्छया॥
en: Thereupon the affixed celestials, Gandharvas, Asuras and men repaired to the Patriarch Brahmă with a view to bring about the wellbeing of created beings.

sa: अयमिन्द्रस्त्रिभुवने नियोगाद्ब्रह्मणः कृतः। इन्द्रार्थे च भवन्तोऽपि यत्नवन्तस्तपोधनाः॥
en: “The present Indra has been appointed the lord of the three worlds by Brahma. O Rishis you are also trying to create another Indra.

sa: ततस्तमऋषिसंघातं निराशं चिन्तयान्वितम्। दर्शयामास राजेन्द्र तेषामर्थे सरस्वती॥
en: The river Sarasvati saw, O king, those Rishis filled with despair and anxiety for want of a commodious tirtha wherein to perform their rites.

sa: बहून्याश्चर्यरूपाणि कुर्वाणा जनसंसदि। इज्यास्त्रे चोपसंधाने पण्डितास्तत्र शोभनाः॥
en: The learned shine in the concourse of men, where they perform many wonderful things and there where sacrificial vessels and their uses are necessary.

sa: तस्य कारन्धमः पुत्रस्त्रेतायुगमुखेऽभवत्। इन्द्रादनवरः श्रीमान् देवैरपि सुदुर्जयः॥
en: His son, Karandhama was born at the commencement of the Treta age, equalling Indra himself, gifted with grace, and invincible even by the immortals.

sa: तिलैब्रीहियवैरिद्धिर्मूलफलैस्तथा। दत्तेन मासं प्रायन्ते श्राद्धेन पितरो नृप॥
en: With sesame seeds, rice, barley, Masha water, root and fruits, if given at Shraddhas, the departed Manes, O king, remain pleased for a month.

sa: हतवाहनभूयिष्ठाः पाण्डवाऽपि युधिष्ठिरम्। अक्षौहिण्या निरुत्साहाः शिष्टया पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Having lost many car-warriors and elephants and horsemen, the residue of the Pandava army, numbering one Akshauhini and overtaken with depression, supported by Yudhishthira.

sa: विघसाशी कथं च स्यात् सदा चैवातिथिप्रियः। अमृताशी सदा च स्यात् पवित्री च सदा भवेत्॥
en: He should eat the residue, (viz., of what remains after serving the deities and guests). Indeed, he should be hospitable towards all that come should be hospitable towards all that come to his house. He should always eat nectar, He should duly observe all rites and celebrate sacrifices.

sa: उक्तस्तैरस्मि गच्छ त्वं ब्रह्मलोकमिति प्रभो। प्रीतेनोक्तसहस्रेण ब्राह्मणानामहं प्रभो। इमं लोकमनुप्राप्तो मा भूत् तेऽत्र विचारणा॥
en: All those Brahmanas and Rishis, O powerful lord, pleased with me, said, do you go to the region of Brahman! It is on account of the merits of that vow that I have succeeded in acquiring this region of very superior happiness. There is no doubt in this.

sa: अथ पर्यायशः सर्वान् वाहनायोपचक्रमे। पर्यायश्चाप्यगस्त्यस्य समपद्यत भारत॥
en: He make the Rishis perform by turns this humiliating work. The day came when it was Agastya's turn to carry the vehicle, O Bharata.

sa: अनेनैव प्रकारेण प्रगृहीतं पुरातनैः। पूर्णाहुतिभिरापूर्णास्त्रिभिः पूर्यन्ति तेजसा॥
en: It is thus that all this was comprehended by the ancients. By the three full and final libations, the full become full with light.

sa: प्रसन्नहृदयाश्चैव सर्वसत्त्वेषु नित्याः। आपृष्ठतापात् स्वाध्याये युक्तास्तान् पूजयाम्यहम्।।१४
en: I adore them that are endued with mercy towards all creatures and who study the Vedas till their back are heated by the Sun.

sa: ऋत्विजस्तमपर्यन्तं सुवर्णनिचयं तथा॥ व्यभजन्त द्विजातिभ्यो यथोत्साहं यथासुखम्।
en: The sacrificial priests, having got that unlimited quantity of riches, distributed it among the Brahmanas gladly and according to the desire of each recipient.

sa: संकल्प मनसा यज्ञं करन्धमसुतात्मजः। बृहस्पतिमुपागम्य वाग्मी वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: (Marutta) having conceived the idea of a sacrifice in his mind the eloquent grandson of Karandhama went to Brihaspati and spoke to him thus.

sa: केचिद् यानैनरा जग्मुः केचिदश्वैर्महाजवैः। काञ्चनैश्च स्थैः केचिज्ज्वलितज्वलनोपमैः॥
en: Some proceeded on carriages and vehicles, some on quick-coursing horses, and some on a arose cars made of gold and effulgent like blazing fires.

sa: समस्तमिह तच्छ्रुत्वा सम्यगेवावधार्यताम्। अहिंसा सर्वभूतानामेतत् कृत्यतमं मतम्॥
en: Hearing it all, do you settle properly (what it should be). Abstention from injuring any creature is considered as the foremost of all duties.

sa: अब्रवीदितरां कन्यामावहेति स कौरवः। अप्यन्याननुपप्रच्छ शङ्कमानः पितुर्वचः॥
en: Doubting my father's words I went to others for asking their opinion. I thought that my father was exceedingly punctilious in matters of morality.
